name: 仲恩生醫 Steminent
mechanism: 異體脂肪 MSC（旁分泌神經保護、誘導自噬清除突變 ataxin-3）
pipeline: Stemchymal®｜SCA1/2/3/6（pan-polyQ）：日本承認審查中（SCA3/6，優先審查）、台灣附款許可並行、美國 Ph2（UCLA+USF，2026，單臂＋自然史對照）
insight: 本社。手握台日 Ph2 隨機雙盲安慰劑對照正面數據 ＋ 日本優先審查 ＋ 最接近取證，是全賽道唯一有 Ph2 對照證據的資產。

updates.text: REPROCELL 送日本製造販賣『承認』申請（SCA3/6）＋『業』許可送神奈川縣

en.name: Steminent Biotherapeutics
en.mechanism: Allogeneic adipose MSC (paracrine neuroprotection; induces autophagy to clear mutant ataxin-3)
en.pipeline: Stemchymal® | SCA1/2/3/6 (pan-polyQ): under Japanese marketing review (SCA3/6, priority review), Taiwan conditional approval in parallel, US Ph2 (UCLA + USF, 2026, single-arm with natural-history control)
en.insight: Us. Holding positive randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled Ph2 data from Taiwan and Japan plus Japanese priority review, and closest to approval — the only asset in the field with controlled Ph2 evidence.

updates.text: REPROCELL filed the Japanese marketing approval application (SCA3/6) and the MAH business licence with Kanagawa Prefecture

name: Biohaven
mechanism: 小分子（麩胺酸調節，利魯唑前驅藥）
pipeline: Troriluzole（BHV-4157）｜pan-SCA：Ph3 全體終點未達、SCA3 次族群近顯著；NDA 遭 FDA CRL
insight: 最領先的口服對手但取證受挫：2025/11 FDA CRL、研發砍 60%。其真實世界外部對照證據不被 FDA 接受，反襯本社隨機對照的方法學優勢。

updates.text: 削減約 60% 研發支出、爭取與 FDA 再協商

en.mechanism: Small molecule (glutamate modulation; riluzole prodrug)
en.pipeline: Troriluzole (BHV-4157) | pan-SCA: Ph3 missed in the overall population, SCA3 subgroup near-significant; NDA received an FDA CRL
en.insight: The most advanced oral rival, but blocked at approval: FDA CRL in 2025/11 and a 60% R&D cut. Its real-world externally controlled evidence was not accepted by the FDA, underscoring our randomised-controlled methodological advantage.

updates.text: Cut R&D spending by about 60% and sought further discussions with the FDA

name: IntraBio
mechanism: 小分子 Levacetylleucine（N-acetyl-L-leucine，口服）
pipeline: IB1001｜CACNA1A 相關疾病（含 SCA6、EA2、FHM1）：Ph3 IB1001-304，2026/05 監管放行、估 2026/09 起始｜同成分 Aqneursa 已於 Niemann-Pick C 上市
insight: 以已上市成分（Aqneursa／levacetylleucine）延伸至 CACNA1A 相關共濟失調，樞紐試驗主要指標為 SARA、n≈60、12 週交叉設計——開發成本與時程風險低於全新分子。SCA6 與本社日本申請適應症重疊，惟屬症狀改善型小分子、非疾病修飾細胞療法，定位可區隔。

updates.text: CACNA1A（含 SCA6）Ph3 樞紐試驗獲美/英/歐/瑞監管放行
NCT07221292 登錄更新，12 站點、估 2026/09 開始收案

en.mechanism: Small molecule levacetylleucine (N-acetyl-L-leucine, oral)
en.pipeline: IB1001 | CACNA1A-related disorders (incl. SCA6, EA2, FHM1): Ph3 IB1001-304, cleared 2026/05, estimated start 2026/09 | the same molecule is marketed as Aqneursa in Niemann-Pick C
en.insight: Extends an already-marketed molecule (Aqneursa / levacetylleucine) into CACNA1A-related ataxia; the pivotal trial uses SARA as primary endpoint, n≈60, 12-week crossover — lower cost and timeline risk than a novel molecule. SCA6 overlaps the indication in our Japan filing, though it is a symptomatic small molecule rather than a disease-modifying cell therapy, so positioning can be differentiated.

updates.text: Ph3 pivotal trial in CACNA1A (incl. SCA6) authorised in US/UK/EU/Switzerland
NCT07221292 registry update: 12 sites, estimated enrolment start 2026/09

name: Vico Therapeutics
mechanism: 反義寡核苷酸 ASO（CAG exon-skipping，源自 LUMC）
pipeline: VO659｜SCA1 / SCA3 / 亨丁頓舞蹈症（HD）：Ph1/2a 進行中（歐洲）
insight: 與本社在 SCA3 重疊、時程遠期。SCA3 CSF 突變 ataxin-3 未見下降、SCA 尚無明確療效，且有 radiculitis 神經根炎安全訊號（鞘內注射 vs 本社靜脈輸注）。

updates.text: 改半年一次給藥的 Ph1/2 收案

en.mechanism: Antisense oligonucleotide (CAG exon skipping, licensed from LUMC)
en.pipeline: VO659 | SCA1 / SCA3 / Huntington’s disease: Ph1/2a ongoing (Europe)
en.insight: Overlaps with us in SCA3 but is years away. CSF mutant ataxin-3 has not fallen in SCA3, there is still no clear SCA efficacy, and radiculitis has appeared as a safety signal (intrathecal dosing vs our intravenous infusion).

updates.text: Moved to dosing a Ph1/2 cohort on a twice-yearly regimen

name: Arrowhead / Sarepta
mechanism: siRNA（RNAi，標的 ATXN2）
pipeline: ARO-ATXN2｜SCA2：Ph1（NCT06672445）收案結束、含台北榮總站點
insight: SCA2 版的上游 gene-silencing，鞘內給藥；本社刻意避開台灣 SCA2 主因。與 Stemchymal（主 SCA3/6）非直接重疊，屬鄰域監控。

updates.text: Ph1（n=39）收滿、2026 年中停止收案，primary completion 估 2026/12

en.mechanism: siRNA (RNAi targeting ATXN2)
en.pipeline: ARO-ATXN2 | SCA2: Ph1 (NCT06672445) enrolment closed, sites include Taipei Veterans General Hospital
en.insight: The SCA2 version of upstream gene silencing, dosed intrathecally; the main reason we deliberately avoid SCA2 in Taiwan. It does not directly overlap Stemchymal (mainly SCA3/6), so this is adjacent-space monitoring.

updates.text: Ph1 (n=39) fully enrolled, enrolment closed mid-2026, primary completion estimated 2026/12

name: Biogen / Ionis
mechanism: 反義寡核苷酸 ASO（標的 ATXN3，非選擇性）
pipeline: BIIB132（ION260）｜SCA3：Ph1（MERA）2023/04 主動放棄
insight: 資源雄厚大廠退出 SCA3 賽道——標的對、載具送不到深部小腦。對含 SCA3 的 Stemchymal 屬正面。注意 Roche 亦持有 ATXN3 ASO 專利，ATXN3 空間不只一家。

updates.text: 宣布停止 SCA3 BIIB132 Ph1（研發優先化重整）

en.mechanism: Antisense oligonucleotide (non-selective, targeting ATXN3)
en.pipeline: BIIB132 (ION260) | SCA3: Ph1 (MERA) discontinued by the sponsor in 2023/04
en.insight: A deep-pocketed large-cap has left the SCA3 field — right target, but the vehicle could not reach the deep cerebellum. Positive for Stemchymal, which covers SCA3. Note that Roche also holds ATXN3 ASO patents; the ATXN3 space has more than one player.

updates.text: Announced it was stopping the SCA3 BIIB132 Ph1 (pipeline reprioritisation)

name: Cure Rare Disease
mechanism: 反義寡核苷酸 ASO（單股，標的 ATXN3）
pipeline: CRD-002｜SCA3：臨床前，IND 預計 2026
insight: 非營利生技，技術與 Vico 同源自 LUMC。2025/05 獲 FDA 孤兒藥資格、CIRM $5.7M 補助。時程落後 Stemchymal 甚多，長線監測。

updates.text: 獲 FDA 孤兒藥資格（SCA3）

en.mechanism: Antisense oligonucleotide (single-stranded, targeting ATXN3)
en.pipeline: CRD-002 | SCA3: preclinical, IND expected 2026
en.insight: A non-profit biotech whose technology comes from LUMC, the same origin as Vico’s. FDA orphan designation in 2025/05 and a $5.7M CIRM grant. Far behind Stemchymal on timeline; long-range monitoring.

updates.text: Received FDA orphan drug designation (SCA3)

name: uniQure 等 AAV 基因療法
mechanism: AAV 基因療法
pipeline: AAV 基因療法｜SCA（多型）：臨床前/早期，離臨床尚遠
insight: 學界與數家 biotech 探索中；uniQure AMT-150（AAV）近年已去優先化。屬遠期低威脅，反映共濟失調領域投資熱度。

en.name: uniQure et al. (AAV gene therapy)
en.mechanism: AAV gene therapy
en.pipeline: AAV gene therapy | SCA (multiple subtypes): preclinical/early, still far from the clinic
en.insight: Explored by academic groups and several biotechs; uniQure’s AMT-150 (AAV) has been deprioritised in recent years. A low, long-dated threat that mainly reflects investment appetite in ataxia.

name: Kissei 橘生製藥
mechanism: 小分子（TRH 類似物，症狀治療）
pipeline: Rovatirelin（KPS-0373）｜脊髓小腦退化 SCD（含 SCA6／SCA31／皮質小腦萎縮）：日本藥證 2021/12 遞交、2023/07 撤回，2025/07 起執行第三次 Ph3 確認試驗（NCT07040137，n=142，主要指標 SARA，估 2027/03 主要完成）
insight: 症狀治療型對手，機轉（TRH 類似物）與 Stemchymal 不同、療效讀出屬間接參考；但監管上高度相關——同為 PMDA、同以 SARA 為主要量表、日本 SCD 市場範疇與本社 SCA3/6 承認申請重疊。PMDA 當年以「現有資料難以核准」要求補做第三個 Ph3，是日本 SCD 療效證據門檻最直接的公開案例。

updates.text: 日本遞交 rovatirelin 藥證申請
PMDA 認為現有資料難核准，撤回申請
宣布啟動追加 Ph3
第三次 Ph3 確認試驗（NCT07040137）開始收案

en.name: Kissei Pharmaceutical
en.mechanism: Small molecule (TRH analogue, symptomatic treatment)
en.pipeline: Rovatirelin (KPS-0373) | spinocerebellar degeneration (SCD, covering SCA6, SCA31 and cortical cerebellar atrophy): filed in Japan 2021/12, withdrawn 2023/07, and running a third Ph3 confirmatory study since 2025/07 (NCT07040137, n=142, SARA primary endpoint, primary completion estimated 2027/03)
en.insight: A symptomatic-treatment rival whose mechanism (a TRH analogue) differs from Stemchymal, so the efficacy read-across is indirect — but the regulatory overlap is close: the same regulator (PMDA), the same primary scale (SARA), and a Japanese SCD market scope that overlaps Steminent's SCA3/6 application. The PMDA's view that the existing data could not support approval, and the resulting demand for a third Ph3, is the most direct public case study of Japan's evidence bar in SCD.

updates.text: Filed the Japanese application for rovatirelin
Withdrew the application after the PMDA said approval was unlikely on existing data
Announced an additional Ph3
Third Ph3 confirmatory study (NCT07040137) began recruiting

name: 學名藥 Riluzole
mechanism: 小分子
pipeline: Riluzole｜SCA（仿單外 off-label）：已上市，僅症狀緩解、無法改變病程
insight: 基準對照，非直接競品；SCA 屬 off-label 使用。

en.name: Generic Riluzole
en.mechanism: Small molecule
en.pipeline: Riluzole | SCA (off-label): marketed, symptomatic relief only, does not modify disease course
en.insight: A baseline comparator rather than a direct competitor; use in SCA is off-label.

name: Solaxa
mechanism: 小分子（4-aminopyridine 再定位）
pipeline: SLX-100｜SCA27B：註冊型臨床試驗（2025/03 宣布），與多家共濟失調卓越中心合作
insight: SCA27B（FGF14 GAA 重複）目前無 FDA 核准療法。試驗部分經費來自 CDMRP 對 UCLA Susan Perlman 醫師的 $7.3M 補助——與本社美國二期同一位主持人。與本社 SCA3/6 不同亞型，但若先取證將是 SCA 領域首個核准藥。

updates.text: 宣布 SCA27B 註冊型臨床試驗

en.mechanism: Small molecule (repurposed 4-aminopyridine)
en.pipeline: SLX-100 | SCA27B: registrational trial announced 2025/03, run with leading ataxia centres of excellence
en.insight: There is no FDA-approved therapy for SCA27B (FGF14 GAA repeat). The trial is funded in part by a $7.3M CDMRP grant to Dr Susan Perlman at UCLA — the same principal investigator as Steminent's US Phase 2. A different subtype from Steminent's SCA3/6, but the first to reach approval would be the first approved drug in SCA.

updates.text: Announced a registrational trial in SCA27B

name: 安基生技 AnnJi
mechanism: 小分子（降解突變雄性素受體、活化 Nrf1/Nrf2）
pipeline: AJ201（rosolutamide）｜SBMA：Ph1b/2a 完成、規劃全球 Ph3；FDA 孤兒藥資格另含 HD 與 SCA
insight: 台灣本土的 polyQ 玩家。臨床目前僅在 SBMA（甘迺迪症），但孤兒藥資格已涵蓋 SCA，是最可能從鄰近適應症切入 SCA 的在地公司。美國權利已授權 Avenue Therapeutics。⚠️ 但美國權利處於爭議中：Avenue 於 2025-03 向國際仲裁法院聲請緊急禁制令，要求禁止安基進一步分析 AJ201 的 1b/2a 檢體，安基則主張對方一再拖延解盲時程、未盡合理商業努力。

updates.text: 與被授權方 Avenue Therapeutics 就 AJ201（授權金上限 2.5 億美元）之解盲時程爆發爭議，Avenue 向國際仲裁法院聲請緊急禁制令
KDA 年會公布全球多中心 Ph3 初步設計；獲 FDA 快速通道

en.name: AnnJi Pharmaceutical
en.mechanism: Small molecule (degrades mutant androgen receptor; activates Nrf1/Nrf2)
en.pipeline: AJ201 (rosolutamide) | SBMA: Ph1b/2a complete, global Ph3 planned; FDA orphan designation also covers HD and SCA
en.insight: A Taiwan-based polyQ player. Clinical work is in SBMA (Kennedy's disease) only, but its orphan designation already covers SCA, making it the local company most likely to enter SCA from an adjacent indication. US rights are licensed to Avenue Therapeutics. Note that the US rights are in dispute: in March 2025 Avenue sought an emergency injunction from the International Court of Arbitration to bar AnnJi from further analysis of the AJ201 Ph1b/2a samples, while AnnJi contends the licensee repeatedly delayed the unblinding schedule and failed to make reasonable commercial efforts.

updates.text: A dispute with licensee Avenue Therapeutics over the AJ201 unblinding schedule (a licence worth up to US$250M) led Avenue to seek an emergency injunction from the International Court of Arbitration
Presented a preliminary global Ph3 design at the KDA conference; received FDA Fast Track

name: Neurolixis
mechanism: 小分子，5-HT1A 受體促效劑
pipeline: NLX-112（befiradol）｜SCA3（另帕金森）：SCA 臨床前／PD Ph2
insight: SCA 適應症已有美歐孤兒藥資格，但 SCA3 僅有動物數據、尚未進入人體；臨床主戰場是帕金森的左旋多巴引發異動症。

en.mechanism: Small molecule, 5-HT1A receptor agonist
en.pipeline: NLX-112 (befiradol) | SCA3 (also Parkinson's): SCA preclinical / PD Ph2
en.insight: Holds US and EU orphan designations in SCA, but SCA3 evidence is animal-only with no human trial yet; its clinical focus is levodopa-induced dyskinesia in Parkinson's.

name: Seelos Therapeutics
mechanism: 自噬誘導，清除蛋白聚集
pipeline: SLS-005（靜脈 trehalose）｜SCA（SCA3 為主）：註冊型 Ph2/3（已暫停）
insight: SCA3 註冊型 Ph2/3 於 2023/04 因商業考量暫停收案、資源轉向 ALS；公開來源未見重啟。孤兒藥資格與快速通道仍在。

en.mechanism: Autophagy induction, clearing protein aggregates
en.pipeline: SLS-005 (IV trehalose) | SCA (mainly SCA3): Registrational Ph2/3 (paused)
en.insight: Its registrational SCA3 Ph2/3 paused enrolment in 2023/04 for business reasons, with resources shifted to ALS; no restart has been reported. Orphan designation and Fast Track remain in place.

name: Wave Life Sciences
mechanism: ASO／RNA 編輯，對偶基因選擇性
pipeline: ATXN3 對偶基因選擇性寡核苷酸｜SCA3：未公開／疑停滯
insight: 平台強項為對偶基因選擇性沉默（HD 的 WVE-003 已顯示選擇性降低突變 HTT）。SCA3 方向自 2018 年宣布將選定候選藥後，公開來源未見進展。

en.mechanism: ASO / RNA editing, allele-selective
en.pipeline: Allele-selective ATXN3 oligonucleotide | SCA3: Undisclosed / apparently dormant
en.insight: Platform strength is allele-selective silencing (WVE-003 in HD showed selective lowering of mutant HTT). On SCA3, no public progress since it said in 2018 it would nominate a candidate.

name: Design Therapeutics
mechanism: 小分子，標的 GAA 重複、提升 frataxin 表現
pipeline: DT-216P2（GeneTAC™）｜Friedreich's Ataxia：Ph1/2（RESTORE-FA）
insight: GeneTAC 小分子鎖定核苷酸重複擴增。2026/05 RESTORE-FA 四週靜脈給藥數據見劑量依存 frataxin 上升與臨床改善，將走註冊路徑（2026 Q4 更新）。技術概念與 polyQ 相通，值得追蹤是否延伸 SCA。

en.mechanism: Small molecule, targets the GAA repeat to raise frataxin
en.pipeline: DT-216P2 (GeneTAC™) | Friedreich's ataxia: Ph1/2 (RESTORE-FA)
en.insight: GeneTAC small molecules target nucleotide repeat expansions. Four-week IV data from RESTORE-FA in 2026/05 showed dose-dependent frataxin increases and clinical improvement, with a registrational path to be updated in Q4 2026. The concept is adjacent to polyQ, so watch for extension into SCA.

name: Larimar Therapeutics
mechanism: 蛋白替代，補充 frataxin
pipeline: Nomlabofusp（CTI-1601）｜Friedreich's Ataxia：滾動式 BLA 進行中
insight: Frataxin 蛋白替代療法。2026/02 獲突破性療法認定、2026/06/29 遞交加速核准滾動式 BLA 第一模組——共濟失調領域少見走到 BLA 的案例。

en.mechanism: Protein replacement, frataxin supplementation
en.pipeline: Nomlabofusp (CTI-1601) | Friedreich's ataxia: Rolling BLA under way
en.insight: A frataxin protein replacement therapy. Breakthrough Therapy designation in 2026/02 and the first module of a rolling BLA for accelerated approval submitted on 2026/06/29 — one of the few ataxia programmes to reach BLA stage.

name: Lexeo Therapeutics
mechanism: AAV 基因療法，提升心肌 frataxin
pipeline: LX2006｜Friedreich's Ataxia 相關心肌病變：註冊型試驗設計定案
insight: AAV 基因療法針對 FA 相關心肌病變。2026/06 樞紐試驗 SUNRISE-FA 2 方案定案，目標 2028 循加速核准遞交 BLA；持有突破性療法、RMAT、孤兒藥、快速通道四項資格。

en.mechanism: AAV gene therapy, raises cardiac frataxin
en.pipeline: LX2006 | Friedreich's ataxia cardiomyopathy: Registrational design finalised
en.insight: AAV gene therapy for FA-associated cardiomyopathy. The SUNRISE-FA 2 pivotal protocol was finalised in 2026/06, targeting a BLA under accelerated approval in 2028; holds Breakthrough, RMAT, Orphan Drug and Fast Track designations.

name: Minoryx Therapeutics
mechanism: 小分子，PPARγ 促效、抗神經發炎
pipeline: Leriglitazone｜Friedreich's Ataxia （另 X-ALD、Rett）：FA 為 Ph2 概念驗證
insight: Leriglitazone 於 FA 有美歐孤兒藥資格與 Ph2 概念驗證，但公司臨床重心已移向 X-ALD 與 Rett 症候群，FA 未見進入樞紐試驗。

en.mechanism: Small molecule, PPARγ agonist, anti-neuroinflammatory
en.pipeline: Leriglitazone | Friedreich's ataxia (also X-ALD, Rett): Ph2 proof-of-concept in FA
en.insight: Leriglitazone holds US and EU orphan designations in FA with a Ph2 proof-of-concept, but the company's clinical focus has moved to X-ALD and Rett syndrome, with no pivotal trial in FA.

name: PTC Therapeutics
mechanism: 小分子，15-LO 抑制、氧化壓力
pipeline: Vatiquinone｜Friedreich's Ataxia：NDA 受挫；新 Ph3 PROVE-FA（NCT07681713）2026/07 登錄
insight: Vatiquinone 的 FA 新藥申請於 2025/08 收到 CRL（未證明實質療效證據）。與 Biohaven 並列「共濟失調小分子在 FDA 卡關」的案例。2026/07 登錄新 Ph3「PROVE-FA」（n≈120、24 個月、主要指標 mFARS，估 2026/08 起始），惟設計為單臂開放標籤、無安慰劑對照。

en.mechanism: Small molecule, 15-LO inhibition, oxidative stress
en.pipeline: Vatiquinone | Friedreich's ataxia: NDA rejected; new Ph3 PROVE-FA (NCT07681713) registered 2026/07
en.insight: Vatiquinone's FA NDA received a CRL in 2025/08 (substantial evidence of efficacy not demonstrated). Together with Biohaven, a case of ataxia small molecules stalling at the FDA. A new Ph3, PROVE-FA, was registered in 2026/07 (n≈120 over 24 months, primary endpoint mFARS, estimated start 2026/08) — but it is single-arm and open-label, with no placebo control.

name: Solid Biosciences
mechanism: AAVhu68 基因療法，密碼子最佳化 FXN cDNA；雙側齒狀核直接注輸＋靜脈雙途徑遞送
pipeline: SGT-212｜Friedreich's Ataxia：Ph1b 首次人體試驗收案中（NCT07180355）
insight: 2026/07/29 主動掃描發現的清單外玩家。其 SGT-212 採「小腦齒狀核直接注輸＋靜脈」雙途徑遞送，正面處理 Biogen BIIB132 當年折戟的深部小腦遞送難題；目前僅 FA 適應症，未見延伸 SCA，但遞送路線值得長期追蹤。

en.mechanism: AAVhu68 gene therapy with codon-optimised FXN cDNA; dual-route delivery by bilateral intradentate nucleus infusion plus IV
en.pipeline: SGT-212 | Friedreich's ataxia: Ph1b first-in-human trial recruiting (NCT07180355)
en.insight: An off-list player picked up by the 2026/07/29 sweep. SGT-212 uses dual-route delivery — direct infusion into the cerebellar dentate nucleus plus an IV dose — addressing head-on the deep-cerebellar delivery problem that sank Biogen's BIIB132. It is in FA only with no announced SCA extension, but the delivery route is worth tracking.

name: REPROCELL
mechanism: 異體 MSC（日本 MAH）
pipeline: Stemchymal®（日本）
insight: 日本製造販賣業者（MAH）。2026/06/18 向神奈川縣申請 MAH 業許可、2026/06/24 向 PMDA 遞交 Stemchymal 製造販賣承認申請（適應症 SCA3、SCA6），走約 9 個月優先審查。

en.mechanism: Allogeneic MSC (Japanese MAH)
en.pipeline: Stemchymal® (Japan)
en.insight: Japanese marketing authorisation holder. Filed for the MAH business licence with Kanagawa Prefecture on 2026/06/18 and submitted the Stemchymal marketing approval application to PMDA on 2026/06/24 (indications SCA3 and SCA6), under a ~9-month priority review.

name: 住友製藥／RACTHERA
mechanism: iPSC 衍生多巴胺神經前驅細胞
pipeline: AMCHEPRY®（raguneprocel）
insight: 2026/03/06 日本厚生勞動省授予附條件期限核准，適應症為對既有療法（含左旋多巴）反應不佳的帕金森病運動症狀——與 RiHEART 並列全球首批 iPSC 衍生細胞治療核准案。Ph1/2 為 7 人植入，4 人見運動功能改善、無相關嚴重不良事件。

en.mechanism: iPSC-derived dopaminergic neural progenitors
en.pipeline: AMCHEPRY® (raguneprocel)
en.insight: On 2026/03/06 Japan's MHLW granted conditional, time-limited approval for motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease in patients not responding to existing therapy including levodopa — together with RiHEART, among the world's first approved iPSC-derived cell therapies. The Ph1/2 implanted 7 patients, with motor improvement in 4 and no related serious adverse events.
en.name: Sumitomo Pharma / RACTHERA

name: Cuorips
mechanism: iPSC 衍生心肌細胞片
pipeline: RiHEART®（ReHeart）
insight: 2026/03/06 獲日本附條件期限核准（心衰竭），與 AMCHEPRY 並列全球首批 iPSC 療法。iPS 心肌細胞片外科貼附於心臟表面，促進血管新生。公開報導之日本國內價格為 5,320 萬日圓（約 32.6 萬美元）；2026 年秋季在日本上市。

en.mechanism: iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte sheets
en.pipeline: RiHEART® (ReHeart)
en.insight: Received Japanese conditional, time-limited approval on 2026/03/06 (heart failure), alongside AMCHEPRY as among the world's first iPSC therapies. Sheets of iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes are surgically applied to the heart surface to promote vascularisation. Reported Japanese price is ¥53.2 million (about US$326,400); launch in Japan planned for autumn 2026.

name: Heartseed
mechanism: iPSC 衍生心肌細胞球
insight: 2026 年 3 月底於信州大學醫院完成 HS-005 首例給藥（EMERALD Ph1/2，擴張型心肌病），為全球首例以導管投與 iPS 心肌細胞球；每 cohort 7 人、共 14 人。既有主力 HS-001 需開胸手術，HS-005 改為經心內膜導管、侵入性較低。

en.mechanism: iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte spheroids
en.insight: Dosed the first HS-005 patient at Shinshu University Hospital in late March 2026 (EMERALD Ph1/2, dilated cardiomyopathy) — the world's first catheter administration of iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte spheroids; 7 patients per cohort, 14 in total. Its earlier lead HS-001 requires open-heart surgery, while HS-005 uses a less invasive endocardial catheter.

name: Healios
mechanism: 體細胞（多能成體前驅細胞）與 iPSC
pipeline: HLCM051（invimestrocel）
insight: 以急性呼吸窘迫症候群（ARDS）為主軸，已於日本遞交全球 Ph3 試驗計畫（REVIVE-ARDS，隨機安慰劑對照、最多 550 人，主要終點為無呼吸器天數），策略上尋求依 Ph2 結果在日本取得附條件期限核准；另有缺血性腦中風與外傷適應症、以及 iPSC 衍生基因改造殺手細胞平台。

en.mechanism: Somatic (multipotent adult progenitor) cells and iPSC
en.pipeline: HLCM051 (invimestrocel)
en.insight: Centred on acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS): a global Ph3 trial plan has been filed in Japan (REVIVE-ARDS, randomised placebo-controlled, up to 550 patients, primary endpoint ventilator-free days), with a strategy of seeking conditional, time-limited approval in Japan on the Ph2 results; also pursuing ischaemic stroke and trauma, plus an iPSC-derived gene-engineered killer cell platform.

name: Cellusion
mechanism: iPSC 衍生角膜內皮細胞
pipeline: CLS001
insight: 2023/03 於日本再生醫療學會年會發表首例人體移植（iPS 衍生角膜內皮細胞替代物）結果：術後 3 個月未見不良事件，視力、角膜中央與最薄厚度呈改善趨勢。現正籌備日本公司主導試驗與全球試驗。

en.mechanism: iPSC-derived corneal endothelial cells
en.pipeline: CLS001
en.insight: Reported the first-in-human transplant at the Japanese Society for Regenerative Medicine annual meeting in 2023/03: no adverse events at 3 months, with trends toward improved visual acuity and central/thinnest corneal thickness. Company-sponsored Japanese and global trials are in preparation.

name: Orizuru Therapeutics
mechanism: iPSC 衍生胰島細胞等再生細胞平台
pipeline: （管線見官網）
insight: 武田與京大 iPS 細胞研究所 T-CiRA 合作衍生的再生醫療公司，聚焦 iPSC 衍生細胞治療平台（含胰島細胞方向）。公開資訊有限，以官網管線為準。

en.mechanism: iPSC-derived islet and other regenerative cell platforms
en.pipeline: (see company pipeline)
en.insight: A regenerative-medicine company spun out of the Takeda–CiRA (T-CiRA) collaboration, focused on iPSC-derived cell therapy platforms including islet cells. Public information is limited; refer to the company pipeline.

name: SCM Lifescience
mechanism: 純系分離異體 MSC（cMSC）
pipeline: Stemchymal®（韓國）等
insight: 2020/10/13 與 Steminent 簽署韓國獨家授權，取得 Stemchymal 於 polyQ 型脊髓小腦萎縮症（PolyQ SCA）在韓國的臨床開發與商業化權利；對價含預付金、法規里程碑金與兩位數銷售權利金。自有平台為純系分離（clonal isolation）MSC。

en.mechanism: Clonally isolated allogeneic MSC (cMSC)
en.pipeline: Stemchymal® (Korea) and others
en.insight: Signed an exclusive Korean licence with Steminent on 2020/10/13 for clinical development and commercialisation of Stemchymal in polyglutamine spinocerebellar ataxia in South Korea; terms include an upfront payment, regulatory milestones and a double-digit royalty. Its own platform is clonally isolated MSC.

name: CorestemChemon
mechanism: 自體骨髓 MSC
pipeline: NeuroNata-R®（lenzumestrocel）
insight: NeuroNata-R 於 2014 年取得韓國附條件核准用於肌萎縮性側索硬化症（ALS），是神經退化領域少數已上市的 MSC 產品；2026/05 韓國食藥處在完成第三期試驗資料後維持其附條件核准並更新仿單。

en.mechanism: Autologous bone-marrow MSC
en.pipeline: NeuroNata-R® (lenzumestrocel)
en.insight: NeuroNata-R received Korean conditional approval in 2014 for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, one of the few marketed MSC products in neurodegeneration; in 2026/05 the MFDS maintained the conditional approval and updated the label after the completed Phase 3.

name: MediPost
mechanism: 臍帶血 MSC
pipeline: Cartistem®
insight: Cartistem 於 2012 年 1 月取得韓國食藥處核准，用於膝關節軟骨缺損，是異體臍帶血 MSC 商業化的早期案例；公司另有神經退化方向的細胞治療研發。

en.mechanism: Cord-blood MSC
en.pipeline: Cartistem®
en.insight: Cartistem was approved by Korea's MFDS in January 2012 for knee cartilage defects, an early example of commercialised allogeneic cord-blood MSC; the company also runs cell-therapy research in neurodegeneration.

name: ENCell
mechanism: 異體 MSC ＋ 細胞/基因 CDMO
pipeline: EN001
insight: EN001 於 2025/03 取得 FDA 孤兒藥資格（夏柯-馬里-杜斯氏病 CMT）；Ph1 未見劑量限制毒性或輸注相關反應，已進入 Ph1b/2a（NCT06328712，CMT1A），並將適應症擴及裘馨氏肌失養症與肌少症。兼營細胞與基因治療 CDMO。

en.mechanism: Allogeneic MSC plus cell/gene CDMO
en.pipeline: EN001
en.insight: EN001 received FDA orphan drug designation in 2025/03 for Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease; the Ph1 showed no dose-limiting toxicity or infusion-related reactions, and it has advanced to Ph1b/2a (NCT06328712, CMT1A), with expansion into Duchenne muscular dystrophy and sarcopenia. It also operates a cell and gene therapy CDMO.

name: S.Biomedics
mechanism: 多能幹細胞衍生多巴胺前驅細胞
pipeline: A9-DPC（TED-A9）
insight: 以 GMP 條件自人類胚胎幹細胞製備高純度腹側中腦多巴胺前驅細胞。2025/07 公布帕金森病 Ph1/2a 12 人移植後一年安全性與療效數據為正面；2026/02 與 Catalent 建立開發與製造夥伴關係。長期追蹤試驗 NCT06477744。

en.mechanism: Pluripotent stem cell-derived dopaminergic progenitors
en.pipeline: A9-DPC (TED-A9)
en.insight: Produces high-purity ventral midbrain dopaminergic progenitors from human embryonic stem cells under GMP. In 2025/07 it reported positive safety and efficacy data one year after transplantation in 12 Parkinson's patients (Ph1/2a); in 2026/02 it entered a development and manufacturing partnership with Catalent. Long-term follow-up trial NCT06477744.

name: Pharmicell
mechanism: 自體骨髓 MSC
pipeline: Cellgram®
insight: Cellgram-AMI（急性心肌梗塞）為韓國最早核准的幹細胞藥品之一（2011），常被引用為全球首個獲核准的間質幹細胞藥；公司另營細胞治療 CDMO 與原料事業。細節請以官網與韓國食藥處公告為準。

en.mechanism: Autologous bone-marrow MSC
en.pipeline: Cellgram®
en.insight: Cellgram-AMI (acute myocardial infarction) was among the first stem cell drugs approved in Korea (2011) and is often cited as the world's first approved mesenchymal stem cell drug; the company also runs cell-therapy CDMO and materials businesses. Verify details against the company site and MFDS announcements.

name: Anterogen
mechanism: 脂肪來源 MSC
pipeline: Cupistem®／Queencell® 等
insight: 以脂肪來源間質幹細胞在韓國食藥處架構下完成商業化的代表企業（Cupistem 用於克隆氏症肛瘻管）——與本社同屬脂肪 MSC 來源。核准細節請以官網與韓國食藥處公告為準。

en.mechanism: Adipose-derived MSC
en.pipeline: Cupistem® / Queencell® and others
en.insight: A leading example of commercialising adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells under Korea's MFDS framework (Cupistem for Crohn's fistula) — the same cell source as Steminent's. Verify approval details against the company site and MFDS announcements.

name: Kangstem Biotech
mechanism: 臍帶血 MSC
pipeline: Furestem 系列
insight: 以臍帶血來源 MSC 平台開發罕病與發炎性疾病療法（如異位性皮膚炎）。公開資訊有限，管線與進度以官網為準。

en.mechanism: Cord-blood MSC
en.pipeline: Furestem series
en.insight: Develops therapies for rare and inflammatory disorders (such as atopic dermatitis) on a cord-blood MSC platform. Public information is limited; refer to the company site for pipeline and status.

name: CHA Biotech
mechanism: 免疫細胞與 MSC 平台、CDMO
pipeline: （平台為主）
insight: 以臍帶血銀行、全球細胞製造與 CDMO 基礎設施為主體的集團型企業，涵蓋免疫細胞與 MSC 平台。公開資訊有限，以官網為準。

en.mechanism: Immune cell and MSC platforms, CDMO
en.pipeline: (platform-centric)
en.insight: A group company built around cord-blood banking, global cell manufacturing and CDMO infrastructure, spanning immune cell and MSC platforms. Public information is limited; refer to the company site.

name: Tego Science
mechanism: 培養組織細胞（角質細胞／纖維母細胞）
pipeline: Kaloderm®／Rosmir® 等
insight: 韓國組織工程與細胞製劑商業化的早期案例（培養皮膚細胞產品）。核准年份與適應症請以官網與韓國食藥處公告為準。

en.mechanism: Cultured tissue cells (keratinocytes / fibroblasts)
en.pipeline: Kaloderm® / Rosmir® and others
en.insight: An early Korean example of commercialised tissue engineering and cell products (cultured skin cell products). Verify approval years and indications against the company site and MFDS announcements.

name: Mesoblast
mechanism: 異體骨髓 MSC
pipeline: Ryoncil®（remestemcel-L-rknd）
insight: 2024/12/18 獲 FDA 核准，用於 2 個月以上兒童的類固醇難治性急性移植物抗宿主病——首個獲 FDA 核准的間質幹細胞（MSC）產品。核准歷程含 BLA 重新遞交與 PDUFA 展延，是異體 MSC 的 BLA 審查與 CMC 放大量產的關鍵先例。

en.mechanism: Allogeneic bone-marrow MSC
en.pipeline: Ryoncil® (remestemcel-L-rknd)
en.insight: Approved by the FDA on 2024/12/18 for steroid-refractory acute graft-versus-host disease in children aged 2 months and older — the first FDA-approved mesenchymal stem cell product. The path included a BLA resubmission and PDUFA extension, making it the key precedent for allogeneic MSC BLA review and CMC scale-up.

name: Cynata Therapeutics
mechanism: iPSC 衍生 MSC（Cymerus™）
pipeline: CYP-001／CYP-004
insight: 以 iPSC 為起始細胞量產 MSC，訴求批次一致性與可規模化。CYP-001（急性 GvHD）隨機雙盲 Ph2 已完成全部 65 人的 100 天主要評估期，頂線數據預計 2026/06；CYP-004（膝骨關節炎）Ph3 結果預計 2026/05。

en.mechanism: iPSC-derived MSC (Cymerus™)
en.pipeline: CYP-001 / CYP-004
en.insight: Manufactures MSC from iPSC starting material, claiming batch consistency and scalability. The randomised double-blind Ph2 of CYP-001 in acute GvHD completed the 100-day primary evaluation for all 65 participants, with topline expected 2026/06; Ph3 results for CYP-004 in knee osteoarthritis are expected 2026/05.

name: BrainStorm Cell Therapeutics
mechanism: 自體 MSC-NTF（分泌神經營養因子）
pipeline: NurOwn®
insight: 神經退化疾病自體 MSC 的代表案例。第一個 Ph3 已完成；2025/05 取得 FDA 同意啟動 Ph3b（ENDURANCE）並以特殊試驗計畫評估（SPA）協議定案設計：約 200 名症狀未滿兩年的中度 ALS 患者，24 週隨機雙盲對照後接 24 週開放延伸。2026/02 已完成募資、備妥啟動。

en.mechanism: Autologous MSC-NTF (neurotrophic factor secreting)
en.pipeline: NurOwn®
en.insight: A leading case of autologous MSC in neurodegeneration. The first Ph3 is complete; in 2025/05 the FDA cleared a Ph3b (ENDURANCE) with the design settled under a Special Protocol Assessment: about 200 patients with moderate ALS and under two years of symptoms, 24 weeks randomised double-blind followed by a 24-week open-label extension. Financing was secured and start-up preparations were under way as of 2026/02.

name: Capricor Therapeutics
mechanism: 異體心臟球衍生細胞
pipeline: Deramiocel（CAP-1002）
insight: 裘馨氏肌失養症心肌病變。2025 年先收到完全回覆信（FDA 要求補療效資料），其後 FDA 撤回該 CRL 並恢復 BLA 審查，新 PDUFA 目標日 2026/08/22，並已排定細胞、組織與基因治療諮詢委員會會議；重新遞交納入 Ph3 HOPE-3 結果。是罕病細胞治療走 RMAT／加速審查的活教材。

en.mechanism: Allogeneic cardiosphere-derived cells
en.pipeline: Deramiocel (CAP-1002)
en.insight: For Duchenne muscular dystrophy cardiomyopathy. It received a Complete Response Letter in 2025 (the FDA sought more efficacy data); the FDA subsequently lifted that CRL and resumed BLA review with a new PDUFA target of 2026/08/22, and an advisory committee meeting has been scheduled; the resubmission includes Ph3 HOPE-3 results. A live case study of RMAT and accelerated review for rare-disease cell therapy.

name: BlueRock Therapeutics（Bayer）
mechanism: 多能幹細胞衍生神經元
pipeline: Bemdaneprocel
insight: 帕金森病神經元replacement。已在 exPDite-2 註冊型 Ph3 完成首例給藥（NCT06944522）——為異體多能幹細胞衍生療法在帕金森病的首個 Ph3 樞紐試驗；收案至多 102 人、美國 7 個站點，主要終點為 78 週的每日「ON 時間（無困擾異動症）」，數據預計 2027。36 個月追蹤持續見正面效果。

en.mechanism: Pluripotent stem cell-derived neurons
en.pipeline: Bemdaneprocel
en.insight: Neuronal replacement in Parkinson's disease. The first patient has been dosed in the registrational exPDite-2 Ph3 (NCT06944522) — the first pivotal Ph3 of an allogeneic pluripotent stem cell-derived therapy in Parkinson's; up to 102 patients at 7 US sites, primary endpoint change in daily ON time without troublesome dyskinesia over 78 weeks, data expected 2027. Positive effects continued at 36 months of follow-up.
en.name: BlueRock Therapeutics (Bayer)

name: Ultragenyx
mechanism: 基因療法與小分子
pipeline: （多項已上市罕病藥）
insight: 以小樣本罕病族群的試驗執行與法規互動著稱，多項罕病藥物已取得核准，是罕病開發營運面的參照對象。

en.mechanism: Gene therapy and small molecules
en.pipeline: (multiple marketed rare-disease drugs)
en.insight: Known for executing trials and managing regulatory interactions in very small rare-disease cohorts, with several approved rare-disease products — an operational reference for rare-disease development.

name: Nido Biosciences
ticker: 未上市 Private（2026 初結束營運）
mechanism: 口服小分子選擇性雄性素受體調節劑（SARM），結合 AR 的 BF3 位點
pipeline: NIDO-361｜SBMA（甘迺迪症）：Ph2（n=54）完成，主要終點肌肉 MRI 瘦肌肉體積未達；美國與歐盟孤兒藥資格
insight: polyQ 鄰近圈層的口服小分子玩家。2020 年由 5AM Ventures 孵化、2023 年亮相時累計募資 1.09 億美元。全球 Ph2 以全身肌肉 MRI 瘦肌肉體積為主要終點，2026/03 登錄公告顯示未見藥物優勢，公司於 2026 年初結束營運；其與 NIH／名古屋／UCL 合作的肌肉 MRI 生物標記方法學已發表於 Neurology（2026/07）。

updates.text: CT.gov 公告 Ph2 結果：主要終點未達；公司於 2026 年初結束營運

en.mechanism: Oral small-molecule selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) binding the BF3 site of AR
en.pipeline: NIDO-361 | SBMA (Kennedy's disease): Ph2 (n=54) complete, primary muscle-MRI lean muscle volume endpoint missed; US and EU orphan drug designation
en.insight: An oral small-molecule player in the adjacent polyQ ring. Incubated by 5AM Ventures in 2020 and launched in 2023 with $109M raised to date. Its global Ph2 used whole-body muscle MRI lean muscle volume as the primary endpoint; registry results posted in 2026/03 showed no drug advantage and the company wound down in early 2026. The muscle-MRI biomarker methodology it developed with the NIH, Nagoya University and UCL was published in Neurology in 2026/07.

updates.text: Ph2 results posted to CT.gov: primary endpoint missed; the company wound down in early 2026

name: Cyto-Facto サイト・ファクト
mechanism: 基因細胞製劑 CDMO（GCTP 準拠）；自有雲端整合製造管理系統 CytoFactory4.0
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜神戶醫療產業都市（KBIC）主廠；已量產商業化 CAR-T、製造過 MSC 臨床試驗品
insight: 仲恩的日本 CDMO。2026-01-14 雙方簽 LOI，將在日本製造 Stemchymal，並朝技轉與商業供貨正式合約推進。日本藥事法把「製造販売業」（上市許可）與「製造業」（實體 GMP 廠）分成兩張執照，REPROCELL 持前者、不含製造，故製造缺口由仲恩自行補上——Cyto-Facto 補的是仲恩自己的洞，不是 REPROCELL 的洞。

updates.text: 與仲恩簽署基本合意書（LOI），就 Stemchymal 日本製造與供應展開合作

en.name: Cyto-Facto Inc.
en.mechanism: Gene and cell therapy CDMO (GCTP-compliant); proprietary cloud-based manufacturing execution system, CytoFactory4.0
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing services | Main plant at Kobe Biomedical Innovation Cluster (KBIC); has produced commercial CAR-T and clinical-grade MSC batches
en.insight: Steminent's Japanese CDMO. The two signed a letter of intent on 14 Jan 2026 to manufacture Stemchymal in Japan, working toward technology transfer and a formal commercial supply agreement. Japan's pharmaceutical law splits the marketing authorisation (MAH) and the physical GMP manufacturing licence into two separate permits; REPROCELL holds the former and its licence never covered manufacturing, so Cyto-Facto fills Steminent's own gap rather than REPROCELL's.

updates.text: Signed a letter of intent with Steminent covering Japanese manufacturing and supply of Stemchymal

name: Terumo BCT 泰爾茂
mechanism: 細胞製程設備與自動化；Quantum Flex 細胞擴增平台（多尺寸反應器，可跑自體／異體／病毒載體／外泌體）
pipeline: 製程平台｜Quantum Flex 於 2022 上市，為少數可從製程開發一路做到商業化製造的系統
insight: 仲恩的製程自動化夥伴。2026-05 雙方合作推進 MSC 後期臨床製造，里程碑達成後仲恩計畫擴大使用 Quantum Flex 以支撐更廣的臨床轉譯與商業化。異體 MSC 的成本結構取決於單批產出規模，設備選型等於提前決定了 COGs 天花板。

updates.text: 與仲恩簽署策略合作，以 Quantum Flex 推進 MSC 後期臨床製造
與 Akron Bio 完成 GMP 級 fibronectin 於 Quantum Flex 擴增 MSC 的等效性研究

en.name: Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies
en.mechanism: Cell-processing equipment and automation; the Quantum Flex cell expansion platform (multiple bioreactor sizes, supporting autologous, allogeneic, viral vector and exosome applications)
en.pipeline: Process platform | Quantum Flex launched in 2022, one of the few systems spanning process development through commercial manufacturing
en.insight: Steminent's process-automation partner. The two announced a collaboration in May 2026 to advance late-stage clinical manufacturing of MSCs; on hitting development milestones Steminent plans to expand its use of Quantum Flex to support broader clinical translation and commercialisation. The cost structure of an allogeneic MSC product is set by batch scale, so the equipment choice effectively fixes the COGs ceiling in advance.

updates.text: Signed a strategic collaboration with Steminent to advance late-stage clinical MSC manufacturing on Quantum Flex
Completed an equivalency study with Akron Bio on GMP-grade fibronectin for MSC expansion on Quantum Flex

name: Histocell
ticker: 未上市 Private（REPROCELL 投資標的）
mechanism: 細胞治療 CDMO 兼臨床階段生技公司；持有 EMA 授權可製造臨床級 MSC 的主細胞庫與工作細胞庫
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜畢爾包／Larrabetzu 800 m² GMP 廠，為歐、美、日客戶製造人用試驗藥
insight: REPROCELL 的歐洲 CDMO 夥伴兼投資標的。已取得 EMA Regulation (EU) 2017/1569 臨床級細胞製造授權與西班牙 AEMPS 的 GMP 認證，且授權範圍明確涵蓋 MSC 的 MCB／WCB。對仲恩而言，這是進入歐洲最短的 GMP 路徑——不必從零找廠，而是沿既有的日本授權夥伴關係往歐洲延伸。

updates.text: 取得以 REPROCELL StemRNA 臨床級 iPSC 製作 MCB/WCB 的 AEMPS GMP 認證

en.name: Histocell S.L.
en.mechanism: Cell therapy CDMO and clinical-stage biopharma; holds EMA authorisation to manufacture clinical-grade MSC master and working cell banks
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | An 800 m² GMP plant in Bilbao / Larrabetzu producing investigational medicinal products for European, US and Japanese clients
en.insight: REPROCELL's European CDMO partner and investee. It holds clinical-grade cell manufacturing authorisation under EMA Regulation (EU) 2017/1569 plus Spanish AEMPS GMP certification, and the scope explicitly covers MSC master and working cell banks. For Steminent this is the shortest route into European GMP — extending an existing Japanese licensing relationship westward rather than sourcing a plant from scratch.

updates.text: Received AEMPS GMP certification for producing MCBs/WCBs from REPROCELL's StemRNA clinical iPSCs

name: 國璽幹細胞 GWOXI
mechanism: 自體脂肪間質幹細胞（與 Stemchymal 同組織來源、異體 vs 自體之別）
pipeline: 思益優 GXNPC1｜慢性缺血性中風：Ph2 完成、2026 向 TFDA 提三期申請；另有四項幹細胞臨床試驗、兩項已達三期
insight: 台灣機轉最接近仲恩的同業——同樣取自脂肪組織的 MSC，差別在自體 vs 異體、適應症在中風而非 SCA。Ph1/2 影像顯示治療六個月後腦損傷區域縮小約 30%。2026 預計取得細胞藥廠 PIC/S GMP 認證、年產能逾千劑（自體與異體皆可），是少數在台灣同時具臨床與產能的本土玩家。

updates.text: 思益優 GXNPC1 慢性缺血性中風向 TFDA 提出三期臨床申請；細胞藥廠預計取得 PIC/S GMP 認證

en.name: GWOXI Stem Cell Applied Technology
en.mechanism: Autologous adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells (same tissue source as Stemchymal; autologous rather than allogeneic)
en.pipeline: GXNPC1 | Chronic ischaemic stroke: Ph2 complete, Ph3 application filed with Taiwan's TFDA in 2026; four stem cell trials running in total, two at Phase 3
en.insight: The Taiwanese peer whose mechanism sits closest to Steminent's — adipose-derived MSCs, differing in being autologous rather than allogeneic and in targeting stroke rather than SCA. Ph1/2 imaging showed roughly a 30% reduction in the damaged brain area six months after treatment. Its cell-drug plant is scheduled for PIC/S GMP certification in 2026 with annual capacity above a thousand doses of both autologous and allogeneic product, making it one of the few domestic players holding clinical assets and capacity at once.

updates.text: Filed a Phase 3 application with the TFDA for GXNPC1 in chronic ischaemic stroke; cell-drug plant scheduled for PIC/S GMP certification

name: 永笙-KY StemCyte
mechanism: 臍帶血幹細胞；持有全球規模最大的公捐臍帶血庫之一
pipeline: REGENECYTE｜已獲美國 FDA 藥證（BLA），用於造血與免疫系統疾病；長新冠 Ph2 已解盲並取得 FDA RMAT、已申請三期樞紐試驗；急性中風主打發病後 6–9 天治療窗
insight: **台灣唯一取得美國 FDA 細胞治療新藥藥證（BLA）的公司**。對仲恩而言，它的價值不在適應症重疊（幾乎沒有），而在它已經走完一次台灣公司拿到 FDA BLA 的完整路徑——法規、CMC、查廠的實戰經驗，正是仲恩美國線最缺的一塊。2026-04 下旬掛牌上市。

updates.text: 掛牌上市；法說會揭示 FDA 藥證＋長新冠＋急性中風「細胞三箭」策略

en.name: StemCyte
en.mechanism: Cord blood stem cells; operator of one of the world's largest public cord blood banks
en.pipeline: REGENECYTE | US FDA-approved (BLA) for haematopoietic and immune disorders; long-COVID Ph2 unblinded with FDA RMAT designation and a pivotal Ph3 application filed; acute stroke programme targeting a 6–9 day post-onset treatment window
en.insight: The only Taiwanese company holding a US FDA biologics licence for a cell therapy. Its value to Steminent lies not in indication overlap (there is almost none) but in having already completed the full path a Taiwanese company must walk to obtain an FDA BLA — the regulatory, CMC and inspection experience that Steminent's US track most lacks. Listed in late April 2026.

updates.text: Listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; investor briefing set out a three-pronged strategy spanning its FDA licence, long COVID and acute stroke

name: 樂迦再生 Leica Regenerative
mechanism: 細胞治療 CDMO；PIC/S GMP 規格智慧細胞廠
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜竹北生醫園區智慧細胞廠，總樓地板約 6,100 坪、24 間細胞操作室，2026 投產
insight: 號稱亞洲最大的 PIC/S GMP 智慧細胞廠。仲恩目前的製造佈局是台灣自製＋日本 Cyto-Facto，但《再生醫療法》2026 元旦上路後台灣進入放量期，本土產能會變成議價籌碼——多一個在地 CDMO 選項，等於在跟日本廠談條件時多一張牌。

updates.text: 竹北智慧細胞廠完工啟用、進入投產

en.name: Leica Regenerative Medicine
en.mechanism: Cell therapy CDMO; PIC/S GMP-grade smart cell manufacturing
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | A smart cell plant at Zhubei Biomedical Park with roughly 20,000 m² of floor area and 24 cell processing suites, entering production in 2026
en.insight: Billed as Asia's largest PIC/S GMP smart cell plant. Steminent's manufacturing footprint today is in-house Taiwanese production plus Cyto-Facto in Japan, but Taiwan enters a volume phase now that the Regenerative Medicine Act took effect on 1 January 2026, and domestic capacity becomes negotiating leverage — a second local CDMO option is another card to hold when setting terms with the Japanese plant.

updates.text: Zhubei smart cell plant completed and entering production

name: 台寶生醫
mechanism: 細胞與基因治療 CDMO；GTP／GMP 產能
pipeline: 受託開發與製造服務｜以跨國策略合作與 GTP/GMP 產能建置切入國際市場
insight: 台灣 CGT CDMO 的代表性業者之一，路線是靠跨國合作把本土產能接上國際客戶。與樂迦同屬「本土產能選項」，差別在台寶較早走國際代工、樂迦以單廠規模取勝。

en.name: Taiwan Bio Therapeutics
en.mechanism: Cell and gene therapy CDMO; GTP/GMP capacity
en.pipeline: Contract development and manufacturing | Entering international markets through cross-border strategic partnerships and GTP/GMP capacity build-out
en.insight: One of the representative CGT CDMOs in Taiwan, pursuing international clients by pairing local capacity with cross-border partnerships. It sits alongside Leica as a domestic capacity option, differing in having moved earlier into international contract work where Leica competes on single-site scale.

name: 長聖國際生技
mechanism: 細胞治療（免疫細胞與幹細胞）
pipeline: 多項細胞治療產品｜被法人點名為《再生醫療法》首波暫時性藥證的主要角逐者之一
insight: 台灣再生醫療法上路後的搶證前段班。與仲恩的關係主要不在適應症競爭，而在**法規賽道競爭**——首批拿到暫時性藥證的公司會定義審查標準與定價錨點，對後續申請者的影響比臨床數據更直接。

updates.text: 法人點名為《再生醫療法》首波暫時性藥證主要角逐者之一

en.name: Ever Supreme Bio Technology
en.mechanism: Cell therapy (immune cells and stem cells)
en.pipeline: Multiple cell therapy products | Named by analysts as a leading contender for one of the first conditional approvals under Taiwan's Regenerative Medicine Act
en.insight: A front-runner in the race for approval now that Taiwan's Regenerative Medicine Act is in force. Its relevance to Steminent is less indication overlap than a regulatory race: whoever wins the first conditional approvals will set the review standard and the pricing anchor, which bears on later applicants more directly than clinical data does.

updates.text: Named by analysts as a leading contender for the first wave of conditional approvals under the Regenerative Medicine Act

name: 向榮生技 UnicoCell
mechanism: 間質幹細胞與細胞分泌物（secretome）平台
pipeline: 慢性腎臟病細胞新藥（2026-02 臨床研究獲國際期刊發表）；細胞分泌物功效檢測平台（2026-04 取得台灣發明專利）
insight: 台灣少數同時做細胞本體與分泌物的業者。分泌物路線與 Stemchymal 的旁分泌機轉論述同源——若未來仲恩要往無細胞（cell-free）的次世代產品走，這條技術線是在地最接近的參照與潛在技術夥伴。

updates.text: 細胞分泌物產品功效檢測平台技術取得台灣發明專利
慢性腎臟病細胞新藥臨床研究獲國際期刊發表

en.name: UnicoCell Biomed
en.mechanism: Mesenchymal stem cells and a cell secretome platform
en.pipeline: A chronic kidney disease cell therapy (clinical research published in an international journal, Feb 2026); a secretome potency assay platform (Taiwanese invention patent granted, Apr 2026)
en.insight: One of the few Taiwanese players working on both cells and their secretome. The secretome route shares its rationale with Stemchymal's paracrine mechanism, making it the closest local reference point — and a potential technology partner — should Steminent move toward a cell-free next-generation product.

updates.text: Granted a Taiwanese invention patent for its secretome potency assay platform
Clinical research on its chronic kidney disease cell therapy published in an international journal

name: OmniaBio／CCRM
ticker: 未上市 Private（CCRM 於 2022 成立）
mechanism: 細胞與基因治療 CDMO；AI 賦能製造；CCRM 為公私合營的再生醫學商業化中心
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜安大略 Hamilton 廠 120,000 平方英尺，2024–2026 分三階段開放、完成後共 57 間無塵室，總投資逾 5.8 億元、250 個技術職缺；加拿大最大 CGT CDMO
insight: **這條線最值得看的不是產能，是誰在用它——Medipost（南韓）是該廠首個商業期客戶兼合作方。** 換句話說，仲恩在韓國原本想談的對象，已經先一步用加拿大產能解決了北美製造與落地問題。這既是可複製的模板，也可能是繞道進入北美的捷徑。CCRM 另於 2026-06 與 Avectas 評估自動化平台、2026-07 與 STEMCELL Technologies 合作供應配對的 GMP／RUO iPSC 品系。

updates.text: CCRM 與 STEMCELL Technologies 合作，供應配對的 GMP 與 RUO iPSC 品系
CCRM 與 OmniaBio 和 Avectas 簽約評估自動化細胞治療製造平台
Hamilton 商業化製造廠啟用，Medipost 為首個商業期客戶

en.name: OmniaBio / CCRM
en.mechanism: Cell and gene therapy CDMO with AI-enabled manufacturing; CCRM is a public-private regenerative medicine commercialisation centre
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | A 120,000 sq ft plant in Hamilton, Ontario opening in three phases across 2024–2026 for a total of 57 cleanrooms, on investment above C$580M and creating 250 skilled jobs; Canada's largest dedicated CGT CDMO
en.insight: The striking fact here is not the capacity but who is using it — Medipost of South Korea is both a partner and the site's first commercial-stage client. The Korean company Steminent had been circling has already solved its North American manufacturing and landing problem using Canadian capacity. That makes this both a replicable template and a possible side door into North America. CCRM separately agreed in June 2026 to evaluate Avectas' automation platform, and in July 2026 to supply matched GMP and RUO iPSC lines with STEMCELL Technologies.

updates.text: CCRM partnered with STEMCELL Technologies to supply matched GMP and RUO iPSC lines
CCRM and OmniaBio agreed to evaluate Avectas' automated cell therapy manufacturing platform
Hamilton commercial manufacturing facility opened with Medipost as its first commercial-stage client

name: Lonza 龍沙
mechanism: 全球 CDMO；異體細胞治療、病毒載體、外泌體與自體細胞治療皆有 cGMP 產線
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜MSC 工業級製造已產出數百批 GMP 批次；針對大規模商業需求優化 COGs 的營運模式；橫跨三大洲
insight: 異體 MSC 商業化最現成的規模化選項。它的差異化不在能不能做，而在**已經把 MSC 的單位成本壓到商業可行**——對一個要靠反覆給藥（仲恩法說會預估每年三劑）的產品來說，COGs 決定了定價與給付談判的空間，比產能本身更關鍵。

en.name: Lonza Group
en.mechanism: Global CDMO with cGMP lines spanning allogeneic cell therapy, viral vectors, exosomes and autologous cell therapy
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | Industrial MSC manufacturing with hundreds of GMP batches produced; an operating model optimised to reduce COGs for large-scale commercial demand; a footprint across three continents
en.insight: The most readily available route to scale for a commercial allogeneic MSC product. What sets it apart is not capability but that it has already driven MSC unit costs down to a commercially viable level — and for a product dosed repeatedly (Steminent's investor guidance assumes three doses a year), COGs governs the room available in pricing and reimbursement negotiations more than capacity does.

name: Miltenyi Biotec 美天旎
mechanism: 細胞與基因治療 CDMO；自動化封閉式細胞製造製程
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜1989 年起投入 CGT、CDMO 資歷 25 年；已產出 700+ 批臨床細胞治療與 400+ 批臨床慢病毒載體；北美、歐洲、亞太皆設廠
insight: 德國唯一具規模的細胞治療 CDMO，且與平台上既有的 CHA Biotech（南韓）已有 BaEV 慢病毒載體平台合作。自動化封閉式製程是它與 Lonza 的路線差異——前者壓縮人力與污染風險，後者壓規模與單位成本，兩條路對應不同的產品階段。

updates.text: 與 CHA Biotech 合作 BaEV 慢病毒載體平台，強化 CAR-NK 製造效率

en.name: Miltenyi Biotec / Miltenyi Bioindustry
en.mechanism: Cell and gene therapy CDMO built on automated, closed-system cell manufacturing
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | In cell and gene therapy since 1989 with 25 years as a CDMO; over 700 clinical cell therapy batches and 400 clinical lentiviral vector batches produced; sites in North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific
en.insight: Germany's only cell therapy CDMO at scale, and already partnered with CHA Biotech of South Korea — also tracked here — on a BaEV lentiviral vector platform. Its automated closed-system approach is the strategic difference from Lonza: closed processing compresses labour and contamination risk, where Lonza competes on scale and unit cost, and the two suit different product stages.

updates.text: Partnered with CHA Biotech on a BaEV lentiviral vector platform to improve CAR-NK manufacturing efficiency

name: Cellistic
mechanism: iPSC 細胞治療專屬製造平台
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜總部 Mont-Saint-Guibert，設有全球首座 EMA 認證且符合 FDA 與 PMDA 規範的專建 iPSC 細胞治療 GMP 廠
insight: 比利時剩下的細胞治療產能主力（Catalent Gosselies 正在收攤，見該筆）。對仲恩的相關性目前是間接的——Stemchymal 是原代脂肪 MSC 不是 iPSC 衍生，但若日後要走 iPSC 來源 MSC（如 Cynata 的 Cymerus 路線）以解決捐贈者變異，這裡是歐洲最成熟的落點。

en.name: Cellistic
en.mechanism: A dedicated iPSC cell therapy manufacturing platform
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | Headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, home to the first purpose-built iPSC cell therapy GMP facility certified by the EMA and compliant with FDA and PMDA requirements
en.insight: The remaining anchor of Belgian cell therapy capacity, with Catalent's Gosselies site winding down (see that entry). Relevance to Steminent is indirect today, since Stemchymal is a primary adipose MSC rather than iPSC-derived — but should the company later pursue iPSC-derived MSCs to eliminate donor variability, as Cynata does with Cymerus, this is Europe's most mature landing site.

name: Catalent（Gosselies 廠）
ticker: Novo Holdings 持有（2024 年底完成收購）
mechanism: 曾為商業級細胞治療與質體 DNA 製造；「歐洲細胞治療卓越中心」
pipeline: ⚠️ 收攤中｜2022 完工的 60,000 平方英尺商業級細胞治療廠一度是全球最大之一；2026 因產量下滑決定收掉 Gosselies 營運，影響約 150 人
insight: 列在這裡不是因為它是夥伴候選，而是因為它是**歐洲細胞治療產能正在退出的警訊**。全球最大的細胞治療廠之一因產量不足而關閉，說明歐洲 CGT 的產能過剩與需求落差是真的——這對仲恩的意義是雙面的：歐洲找代工的議價空間變好，但也要小心把供應綁在一個可能撤守的廠區。設備與人才短期內會流入市場。

updates.text: 宣布收掉 Gosselies 細胞治療與質體營運，約 150 人受影響
Catalent 由 Novo Holdings 完成收購

en.name: Catalent (Gosselies site)
en.ticker: Owned by Novo Holdings (acquisition closed late 2024)
en.mechanism: Formerly commercial-scale cell therapy and plasmid DNA manufacturing; billed as a European Centre of Excellence for cell therapy
en.pipeline: Winding down | The 60,000 sq ft commercial cell therapy plant completed in 2022 was once among the world's largest; in 2026 Catalent moved to close the Gosselies operation on declining volumes, affecting around 150 staff
en.insight: Listed not as a partner candidate but as a warning sign that European cell therapy capacity is exiting. One of the world's largest cell therapy plants closing for want of volume says the overcapacity gap in European CGT is real. The implication for Steminent cuts both ways: bargaining power when sourcing European contract manufacturing improves, but tying supply to a site that may retreat carries its own risk. Equipment and talent will reach the market in the near term.

updates.text: Announced the wind-down of cell therapy and plasmid operations at Gosselies, affecting around 150 staff
Catalent's acquisition by Novo Holdings completed

name: STEMCELL Technologies
mechanism: 細胞培養試劑與起始材料供應；GMP 與研究級 iPSC 品系製造配銷
pipeline: 供應鏈服務｜2026-07 與 CCRM 合作，製造並全球配銷源自 LineaBio GMP iPSC 品系的研究級（RUO）品系，並提供可配對的 GMP 品系
insight: 細胞治療的上游供應端。「研究級與 GMP 級可配對」這件事解決的是產業長年的痛點——研發期用一種細胞、進臨床要換另一種，等於重跑一次製程驗證。對任何要從實驗室走到臨床的細胞產品，這是可省下數月的槓桿點。

updates.text: 與 CCRM 合作供應配對的 GMP 與 RUO iPSC 品系

en.name: STEMCELL Technologies
en.mechanism: Cell culture reagents and starting materials; manufacture and distribution of GMP and research-grade iPSC lines
en.pipeline: Supply chain services | Partnered with CCRM in July 2026 to manufacture and globally distribute research-use-only lines derived from LineaBio's GMP iPSC lines, with matched GMP lines available
en.insight: The upstream supply end of cell therapy. Matching research-grade to GMP-grade lines addresses a long-standing industry pain point: developing on one cell source and switching to another for the clinic means repeating process validation. For any cell product moving from bench to clinic, this is a lever worth months.

updates.text: Partnered with CCRM to supply matched GMP and RUO iPSC lines

name: Xintela
mechanism: 以標記篩選（integrin α10β1）的異體間質幹細胞 XSTEM；另有 EQSTEM 動物用產品線
pipeline: XSTEM｜難癒性靜脈腿部潰瘍 Ph1/2a 達主要安全性目標；膝關節炎臨床試驗進行中。自建 ATMP GMP 廠並獲瑞典藥品管理局製造許可
insight: 瑞典唯一具規模的幹細胞 ATMP 公司，也是歐洲少數自有 GMP 產能的異體 MSC 開發者。它的標記篩選技術正對應異體 MSC 最被詬病的批次一致性問題。⚠️ 2026-06 股價約 US$0.02，屬財務困難狀態——這反而讓「取得其 GMP 產能或技術」的成本遠低於自建，但也代表往來前要先評估其存續風險。

updates.text: 股價約 US$0.02，財務狀況緊繃
XSTEM 難癒性靜脈腿部潰瘍 Ph1/2a 安全且耐受良好，達主要目標

en.name: Xintela AB
en.mechanism: XSTEM, an allogeneic mesenchymal stem cell product selected on the integrin α10β1 marker; plus the EQSTEM veterinary line
en.pipeline: XSTEM | Ph1/2a in difficult-to-heal venous leg ulcers met its primary safety objective; a knee osteoarthritis study is running. Operates its own ATMP GMP facility licensed by the Swedish Medical Products Agency
en.insight: Sweden's only stem cell ATMP company of any scale, and one of the few European allogeneic MSC developers with in-house GMP capacity. Its marker-based selection speaks directly to the batch-consistency criticism that dogs allogeneic MSCs. Note that its share price sat near US$0.02 in June 2026, indicating financial distress — which makes acquiring its GMP capacity or technology far cheaper than building equivalent capability, while also demanding a solvency assessment before any engagement.

updates.text: Share price around US$0.02, indicating financial strain
XSTEM was safe and well tolerated in the Ph1/2a in difficult-to-heal venous leg ulcers, meeting the primary objective

name: Anthony Nolan
mechanism: 血液幹細胞與臍帶組織捐贈登錄與供應
pipeline: 起始material供應｜2026-05-05 與 INmune Bio 簽訂修訂後的材料移轉暨授權合約，長期供應臍帶組織供 CORDStrom 平台使用，涵蓋英、歐、美
insight: 異體細胞治療的最上游——捐贈者來源。它在 INmune Bio 案裡的角色說明了一件事：**異體產品的長期供貨風險不在工廠，在捐贈者材料的取得權**。仲恩用的是脂肪組織來源，供應鏈結構不同，但「先鎖定長期材料來源再談產能」的順序是可借鏡的。

updates.text: 與 INmune Bio 簽訂修訂後的材料移轉暨授權合約，長期供應臍帶組織

en.name: Anthony Nolan
en.mechanism: Blood stem cell and umbilical cord tissue donor registry and supply
en.pipeline: Starting material supply | Signed an amended and restated material transfer and licence agreement with INmune Bio on 5 May 2026 for long-term cord tissue supply to the CORDStrom platform, covering the UK, EU and US
en.insight: The furthest upstream point in allogeneic cell therapy — donor sourcing. Its role in the INmune Bio deal illustrates a general point: the long-term supply risk in an allogeneic product lies less in the factory than in the right to obtain donor material. Steminent draws on adipose tissue and so faces a different supply chain, but the sequencing — secure long-term material rights before negotiating capacity — transfers.

updates.text: Signed an amended and restated material transfer and licence agreement with INmune Bio for long-term cord tissue supply

name: INmune Bio
mechanism: CORDStrom｜臍帶來源異體 MSC，經檢驗、篩選、混合（pooled）建立標準化「MSC Bank」
pipeline: CORDStrom｜RDEB（隱性失養性水疱性表皮鬆解症）預計 2026 仲夏於英國送 MAA，隨後送 EMA 與 FDA；另拓展 CORDStrom-TRAIL（腫瘤）、骨關節炎與紅斑性狼瘡
insight: **目前最值得盯的異體 MSC 法規先例。** 它與仲恩面對的是同一組難題（捐贈者變異、製造一致性），解法是把多位捐贈者的細胞混合成標準化細胞庫。若 RDEB 的 MAA 在英國過關，將是歐洲第一個以 pooled MSC 取證的案例，直接影響 EMA 對異體 MSC 的可比性與效價要求——仲恩之後進歐洲，審查官心裡的標準會是它訂的。2026-07-20 已宣布完成支持全球註冊送件的商業化製造里程碑。

updates.text: 宣布完成支持全球註冊送件的 CORDStrom 商業化製造里程碑
與 Anthony Nolan 擴大合作，確保臍帶組織長期供應，涵蓋英、歐、美

en.name: INmune Bio Inc.
en.mechanism: CORDStrom — allogeneic cord-derived MSCs that are tested, screened and pooled into standardised MSC banks
en.pipeline: CORDStrom | An MAA for recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa was targeted for the UK in mid-summer 2026, with EMA and FDA submissions to follow; the platform is also being extended to CORDStrom-TRAIL in oncology, osteoarthritis and lupus
en.insight: The allogeneic MSC regulatory precedent most worth watching. It faces the same problems as Steminent — donor variability and manufacturing consistency — and answers them by pooling cells from multiple donors into standardised banks. If the RDEB MAA clears in the UK it becomes Europe's first approval of a pooled MSC product, which will shape how the EMA frames comparability and potency requirements for allogeneic MSCs. When Steminent later enters Europe, the standard in the reviewer's mind will be the one this sets. The company announced on 20 July 2026 that it had completed the commercial manufacturing milestone supporting its planned global filings.

updates.text: Completed the CORDStrom commercial manufacturing milestone supporting planned global registration filings
Expanded its Anthony Nolan collaboration to secure long-term cord tissue supply across the UK, EU and US

name: NurExone Biologic
mechanism: MSC 衍生外泌體載 PTEN siRNA（ExoPTEN），非細胞（cell-free）給藥
pipeline: ExoPTEN｜急性脊髓損傷：2026 預計啟動首次人體 Ph1/2a（C5–T10、ASIA A/B、傷後 3–7 天內收案）；另探索視神經損傷、創傷性腦損傷與顏面神經。已獲 FDA 與 EMA 孤兒藥資格
insight: 無細胞路線的代表。它把 MSC 的治療訊號抽出來裝進外泌體，繞開活細胞的低溫物流、存活率與免疫排斥問題——這正是 Stemchymal 這類活細胞產品的結構性成本來源。適應症完全不重疊（脊髓損傷 vs SCA），所以是純技術面的互補而非競爭；對仲恩來說是「次世代該不該走無細胞」這題的活體實驗。

updates.text: 預計啟動 ExoPTEN 急性脊髓損傷首次人體 Ph1/2a 試驗

en.name: NurExone Biologic Inc.
en.mechanism: MSC-derived exosomes loaded with PTEN siRNA (ExoPTEN), delivered cell-free
en.pipeline: ExoPTEN | Acute spinal cord injury: a first-in-human Ph1/2a was planned for 2026 (levels C5–T10, ASIA grade A or B, enrolled 3–7 days post-injury); optic nerve damage, traumatic brain injury and facial nerve injury are also being explored. Orphan drug designation granted by both the FDA and the EMA
en.insight: The standard-bearer for the cell-free route. It extracts the therapeutic signal of MSCs into exosomes, sidestepping the cold chain, viability and immune-rejection problems of living cells — precisely the structural cost drivers of a live-cell product like Stemchymal. The indications do not overlap at all (spinal cord injury versus SCA), making this technical complementarity rather than competition, and a live experiment in whether a cell-free next generation is worth pursuing.

updates.text: Planned initiation of the first-in-human Ph1/2a of ExoPTEN in acute spinal cord injury

name: 賽萊拉 Sclnow
mechanism: 臍帶間質幹細胞（異體）
pipeline: 19#iSCLife®-SA｜脊髓小腦失調症（SCA）：NCT03378414，登錄之預估開始日為 2026-12-31
insight: **全球第二個把細胞治療推進 SCA 的公司，也是 Stemchymal 在細胞治療賽道上唯一的正面對手。** 差別在細胞來源（臍帶 vs 脂肪）與市場（中國 vs 台日美韓）。目前仍停在登錄階段、尚未有讀出，威脅是未來式；但它的存在破除了「細胞治療賽道全空」的假設，若中國先出數據，會直接影響 SCA 細胞治療的敘事主導權。

updates.text: NCT03378414 登錄之預估開始日為 2026-12-31，尚無讀出

en.name: Sclnow Biotechnology
en.mechanism: Allogeneic umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells
en.pipeline: 19#iSCLife®-SA | Spinocerebellar ataxia: NCT03378414, with a registered estimated start date of 31 December 2026
en.insight: The second company worldwide to push a cell therapy into SCA, and Stemchymal's only head-on rival within the cell therapy lane. The differences are cell source (cord versus adipose) and market (China versus Taiwan, Japan, the US and Korea). It remains at the registration stage with no readout, so the threat is prospective — but its existence disproves the assumption that the cell therapy lane is empty, and a Chinese readout arriving first would shift who controls the narrative in SCA cell therapy.

updates.text: NCT03378414 carries a registered estimated start date of 31 December 2026; no readout yet

name: Denali Therapeutics
mechanism: TransportVehicle（TV）血腦障壁穿透平台；DNL422（OTV:SNCA）直接靶向 α-synuclein 以減少毒性聚集
pipeline: DNL422｜仍在 IND-enabling 階段、主打帕金森病；列於 2025–2027 IND-enabling 名單，最快 2026 進臨床
insight: 與 MSA 的關聯是機轉相鄰而非直接競爭：MSA 與帕金森同屬 α-synuclein 病變，但 MSA 的病灶在寡突膠細胞、帕金森在神經元，靶細胞不同，藥物未必能直接跨過去。真正值得注意的是 TV 平台——如果血腦障壁遞送被解決，整個「打得到標的但送不進去」的失敗類別（BIIB132、VO659 都死在這）會被重新洗牌。

updates.text: DNL422 仍處 IND-enabling 階段，最快 2026 進入臨床

en.name: Denali Therapeutics
en.mechanism: The TransportVehicle (TV) blood-brain-barrier platform; DNL422 (OTV:SNCA) targets alpha-synuclein directly to reduce toxic aggregates
en.pipeline: DNL422 | Still IND-enabling and aimed at Parkinson's disease; listed among the 2025–2027 IND-enabling programmes and could enter trials as early as 2026
en.insight: Its link to MSA is mechanistic adjacency rather than direct competition: MSA and Parkinson's are both synucleinopathies, but MSA pathology sits in oligodendrocytes and Parkinson's in neurons, so a drug does not necessarily carry across. The part that matters is the TV platform — if blood-brain-barrier delivery is genuinely solved, the whole failure category of drugs that engage their target but cannot reach it (where both BIIB132 and VO659 died) gets reshuffled.

updates.text: DNL422 remains in IND-enabling work and could enter the clinic as early as 2026

name: Servier 施維雅
mechanism: 大型製藥集團；於 SCA3 領域以資助世代研究與 AI 資料分析切入，尚無公開的 SCA 在研藥物
pipeline: 無公開 SCA 在研資產｜2022-03-18 與 DZNE 統籌的 ESMI（歐洲 SCA3／馬查多－約瑟夫病聯盟）簽三年合作：Servier 支付世代成員年度回診費用並以 AI 與計算方法協助分析，換取逾 450 名 SCA3 帶因者、跨五國的標準化世代資料
insight: ⚠️ **這是 2022 年的舊約、三年期程推算應已屆滿，現況未公開，不可當成 2026 新動態解讀。** 但它的意義沒有過期：一家大藥廠已經用最便宜的方式（資助自然史世代）在 SCA3 卡了位，拿到的是定義試驗終點所需的基準資料。ESMI 成員含 UCL、Radboud UMC、Coimbra 大學與四所德國大學醫院——這同時也是歐洲 SCA3 臨床網絡的名單。

updates.text: 與 DZNE 統籌之 ESMI 簽署三年合作，資助 SCA3 世代追蹤並協助 AI 資料分析（現況未公開）

en.name: Servier Laboratories
en.mechanism: A large pharmaceutical group that entered SCA3 by funding cohort research and AI data analysis rather than with a disclosed drug candidate
en.pipeline: No disclosed SCA asset | On 18 March 2022 it signed a three-year agreement with ESMI, the European Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 3/Machado-Joseph Disease Initiative coordinated by DZNE: Servier covers the cost of annual study visits and contributes AI and computational analysis in return for access to standardised data on more than 450 SCA3 mutation carriers across five countries
en.insight: This is a 2022 agreement whose three-year term has likely expired, with no public update — it should not be read as a 2026 development. Its significance has not expired, though: a large pharmaceutical company staked a position in SCA3 by the cheapest available route, funding a natural history cohort, and what it obtained is the baseline data needed to define trial endpoints. ESMI's membership — UCL, Radboud UMC, the University of Coimbra and four German university hospitals — doubles as the roster of Europe's SCA3 clinical network.

updates.text: Signed a three-year agreement with DZNE-coordinated ESMI funding SCA3 cohort follow-up and contributing AI data analysis (current status undisclosed)

name: Synapticure
mechanism: 虛擬（遠距）神經退化疾病照護網絡；動作障礙專科神經科醫師、遺傳諮詢、縱貫式照護
pipeline: 全國性 ataxia 照護方案｜2026-07-16 啟動，可與病人既有醫療團隊共同照護；與 Biogen 合作支持疾病衛教與意識推廣
insight: **直接對應仲恩美國線最尷尬的缺口——目前無合作對象、病人只能自行接洽。** 這類虛擬照護網絡解的是罕病最貴的一段成本：找到分散在全美各地、且確診正確的病人。值得注意的是 Biogen 已經先一步接上——這是一家剛放棄自家 SCA3 ASO 的公司，卻仍在維持與 ataxia 病人社群的接觸點，這件事本身就是訊號。

updates.text: 推出全國性虛擬 ataxia 照護方案，與 Biogen 合作進行疾病衛教

en.name: Synapticure
en.mechanism: A virtual care network for neurodegenerative disease offering movement-disorder-trained neurologists, genetic counselling and longitudinal care
en.pipeline: Nationwide ataxia care programme | Launched 16 July 2026, able to co-manage patients alongside their existing care team; partnered with Biogen on disease education and awareness
en.insight: This speaks directly to the most awkward gap on Steminent's US track — no partner in place, with patients reaching out on their own. A virtual care network addresses the most expensive problem in rare disease: finding correctly diagnosed patients scattered across a continent. Note that Biogen got there first — a company that had abandoned its own SCA3 ASO yet is still maintaining a touchpoint with the ataxia patient community, which is itself a signal.

updates.text: Launched a nationwide virtual ataxia care programme with Biogen supporting disease education

name: DZNE／ESMI 聯盟
mechanism: 德國神經退化疾病中心（DZNE）統籌的歐洲 SCA3／馬查多－約瑟夫病聯盟（ESMI）
pipeline: 世代研究｜逾 450 名 SCA3 帶因者、跨五國、標準化臨床檢查流程；已建立腦部變化與生物標記的既有洞察。成員含 Coimbra 大學、Azores 大學、Valdecilla 研究所、Radboud UMC、UCL，以及亞琛／埃森／海德堡／杜賓根大學醫院
insight: 歐洲 SCA3 的臨床與資料樞紐。對仲恩的價值有兩層：一是**外部對照的資料來源**（仲恩美國 Ph2 不設安慰劑對照，需要自然史對照）；二是**歐洲臨床站點的入口名單**——ESMI 的成員機構就是日後歐洲試驗要找的中心。Servier 已經用資助的方式接上這條線，路徑是現成的。

en.name: DZNE / ESMI consortium
en.mechanism: The European Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 3/Machado-Joseph Disease Initiative (ESMI), coordinated by the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE)
en.pipeline: Cohort research | More than 450 SCA3 mutation carriers across five countries under standardised clinical examination protocols, with established insights into brain changes and biomarkers. Members include the University of Coimbra, the University of the Azores, the Valdecilla research institute, Radboud UMC, UCL and the university hospitals of Aachen, Essen, Heidelberg and Tübingen
en.insight: Europe's clinical and data hub for SCA3, valuable to Steminent on two counts. First as a source of external control data, since the US Phase 2 runs without a placebo arm and needs natural history comparators. Second as the entry list for European clinical sites — ESMI's member institutions are the centres any future European trial would need to recruit. Servier has already connected to this network by funding it, so the path is well trodden.

name: Biocells Medical
mechanism: 神經誘導間質幹細胞（neuroinduced MSC）＋外泌體併用；鞘內與鼻內兩種給藥途徑
pipeline: 神經誘導 MSC ＋ 外泌體｜脊髓小腦失調症（全亞型）：NCT07467733，Ph1/2、預估收案 90 人、2026-06 起、主要完成 2028-06，站點在華沙
insight: **細胞治療賽道上第三個進入 SCA 的玩家，也是最容易被漏掉的一個**（登錄名稱用的是 spinocerebellar palsy）。三點值得注意：一、預估收案 90 人，比仲恩美國 Ph2（n≈20）大得多；二、同時給細胞與外泌體，等於把「活細胞 vs 無細胞」兩條路押在同一個試驗裡；三、採鞘內＋鼻內給藥，直接挑戰中樞遞送這個 SCA 領域反覆致命的環節（BIIB132、VO659 都死在送不到）。若它先讀出，會同時衝擊仲恩的靜脈給藥論述與細胞治療賽道的先行者地位。

updates.text: NCT07467733 登錄之預估開始日；Ph1/2、n=90、鞘內＋鼻內給藥，尚未收案

en.mechanism: Neuroinduced mesenchymal stem cells combined with exosomes, delivered both intrathecally and intranasally
en.pipeline: Neuroinduced MSC + exosomes | Spinocerebellar ataxia (all subtypes): NCT07467733, Ph1/2, estimated enrolment of 90, starting June 2026 with primary completion in June 2028, at a site in Warsaw
en.insight: The third player to enter SCA within the cell therapy lane, and the easiest to miss — the registry lists the condition as spinocerebellar palsy. Three things stand out. Its estimated enrolment of 90 is far larger than Steminent's US Ph2 at roughly 20. It administers cells and exosomes together, effectively betting on the live-cell and cell-free routes within a single trial. And it uses intrathecal plus intranasal delivery, taking direct aim at CNS delivery — the step that has repeatedly proved fatal in this field, killing both BIIB132 and VO659. An early readout would pressure both Steminent's intravenous delivery rationale and its first-mover position in the lane.

updates.text: Registered estimated start date for NCT07467733; Ph1/2, n=90, intrathecal plus intranasal, not yet recruiting

name: CRC-SCA／READISCA 聯盟
mechanism: National Ataxia Foundation 支持、Ashizawa 主持的 17 站美國 SCA 臨床研究合作組（CRC-SCA）；READISCA 為 NIH 資助的 SCA1/3 試驗準備延伸
pipeline: 世代研究｜累計逾 1,000 名 SCA1/2/3/6 病人的標準化自然史與生物標記資料；READISCA 提供 SCA1/3 的試驗準備基線
insight: 全美最大的 SCA 自然史與生物標記庫。對仲恩最直接的價值是**美國 Ph2 單臂設計的外部對照來源**——同一類資料已被 Biohaven 登錄用作外部對照（NCT06529146）。學術聯盟主動尋求業界合作，非零和關係。

en.name: CRC-SCA / READISCA consortium
en.mechanism: A 17-site US Clinical Research Consortium for SCA (CRC-SCA) supported by the National Ataxia Foundation and led by Ashizawa; READISCA is an NIH-funded SCA1/3 trial-readiness extension
en.pipeline: Cohort research | Standardised natural-history and biomarker data on more than 1,000 SCA1/2/3/6 patients; READISCA provides SCA1/3 trial-readiness baselines
en.insight: The largest SCA natural-history and biomarker repository in the US. Its most direct value to Steminent is as an external-control source for the single-arm US Phase 2 — the same class of data has already been registered by Biohaven as an external control (NCT06529146). The consortium actively seeks industry collaboration; this is not zero-sum.

name: 台北榮總 SCA 世代
mechanism: 台北榮民總醫院——台灣全國 SCA 轉診中心；Lan／Soong Bing-Wen 神經科團隊
pipeline: 世代研究｜橫跨 25 年、876 例／514 家系的基因與病程資料，以 SCA3 為大宗；另有華人 vs 高加索進展速率比較（n=199）
insight: 仲恩母國最完整的在地 SCA 世代，也是 Arrowhead 收 SCA2 的站點。作為台灣本土公司，仲恩與此中心合作的冷啟動成本最低——是台灣附款許可在地對照與臨床網絡的天然入口。

en.name: Taipei VGH SCA cohort
en.mechanism: Taipei Veterans General Hospital — Taiwan's national SCA referral centre; the Lan/Soong Bing-Wen neurology group
en.pipeline: Cohort research | 25 years of genetic and progression data on 876 cases across 514 families, dominated by SCA3; plus a Han-vs-Caucasian progression comparison (n=199)
en.insight: The most complete local SCA cohort in Steminent's home country, and the site where Arrowhead runs its SCA2 trial. As a domestic Taiwanese company, Steminent has the lowest cold-start cost to partner here — a natural entry to the local comparator and clinical network for the Taiwan conditional approval.

name: EUROSCA／RISCA 世代網絡
mechanism: 波昂（DZNE/波昂大學）統籌的泛歐 SCA 自然史世代：EUROSCA（症狀期）＋RISCA（發病前）；Klockgether／Jacobi／Durr
pipeline: 世代研究｜EUROSCA 17 中心／10 國、基線 526 人，建立各亞型 SARA 年進展速率的歐洲基準；RISCA 14 中心／7 國、追蹤發病前帶因者
insight: 全球被引用最多的 SCA 自然史基準。與同樞紐的 ESMI 互補——ESMI 是 SCA3 臨床樞紐，EUROSCA/RISCA 提供泛亞型進展基準與發病前世代。引用它等於借用整個歐洲學界的可信度。

en.name: EUROSCA / RISCA cohort network
en.mechanism: Bonn-coordinated (DZNE/University of Bonn) pan-European SCA natural-history cohorts: EUROSCA (symptomatic) and RISCA (pre-symptomatic); Klockgether/Jacobi/Durr
en.pipeline: Cohort research | EUROSCA spans 17 centres in 10 countries with 526 at baseline, establishing Europe's per-subtype annual SARA progression benchmark; RISCA spans 14 centres in 7 countries following pre-symptomatic carriers
en.insight: The world's most-cited SCA natural-history benchmark. Complementary to the same-hub ESMI — ESMI is the SCA3 clinical hub, while EUROSCA/RISCA provide the pan-subtype progression baseline and the pre-symptomatic cohort. Citing it borrows the credibility of the entire European academic community.

name: 日本 SCA 自然史世代
mechanism: Yasui 等主持的日本多中心 SCA 自然史研究（SCA6 病程資料）
pipeline: 世代研究｜日本多中心 SCA6 三年病程追蹤（n≈46）
insight: 日本在地世代，直接對應本社日本申請的 SCA3/6 與 REPROCELL 的商業化市場。樣本數不大，但在 PMDA 審查與日本定價脈絡下，「日本自己的資料」比外國世代更具說服力。與 REPROCELL 的 MAH 角色互補。

en.name: Japanese SCA natural-history cohort
en.mechanism: A Japanese multicentre SCA natural-history study led by Yasui et al. (SCA6 progression data)
en.pipeline: Cohort research | Japanese multicentre three-year SCA6 progression follow-up (n≈46)
en.insight: A local Japanese cohort mapping onto Steminent's Japan filing (SCA3/6) and REPROCELL's commercial market. The sample is small, but in the PMDA-review and Japanese-pricing context 'Japan's own data' is more persuasive than a foreign cohort. Complementary to REPROCELL's MAH role.

name: 中國 SCA3 NfL 世代
mechanism: Li 等（中國）以華人族群驗證血清神經絲輕鏈（NfL）作為 SCA3 血液生物標記
pipeline: 世代研究｜116 名 SCA3 ＋ 91 名對照，驗證血清 NfL 追蹤病程與療效
insight: 生物標記方法學參照，非市場對象。中國非本社目標市場，收錄理由是它補足學術層的『生物標記工具』面——若未來試驗想用血液 NfL 追療效，這是華人族群已驗證的參照。定位為觀察。

en.name: China SCA3 NfL cohort
en.mechanism: Li et al. (China) validated serum neurofilament light (NfL) as a blood biomarker for SCA3 in a Han-Chinese population
en.pipeline: Cohort research | 116 SCA3 patients + 91 controls, validating serum NfL for tracking progression and treatment effect
en.insight: A biomarker-methodology reference, not a market target. China is not a Steminent target market; it is included to round out the biomarker-tools dimension of the academic layer — a Han-Chinese validated reference if a future trial uses blood NfL. Positioned as watch.

name: Cell-Easy
mechanism: 細胞治療 CDMO；CellReady® 異體間質幹細胞平台。可處理 15 種細胞型別（T 細胞、NK、Treg、MSC、iPS、永生化細胞株）
pipeline: 受託開發與製造＋自有平台｜土魯斯（4 bis avenue Hubert Curien）；A-MUSE Ph1/2 與土魯斯大學醫院（CHU Toulouse）合作，以 CellReady 異體 MSC 治療全身性硬化症，2026-01 啟動
insight: 法國唯一同時具備異體 MSC 製造能力與自有臨床程式的業者，且製造品質體系對齊 ICH Q2(R1)、歐洲藥典與 EMA／MHRA。對仲恩的意義是「歐洲第二選項」——Histocell 是沿 REPROCELL 關係往西的最短路徑，Cell-Easy 則是不依賴既有關係、可獨立評估的替代方案，且它自己就在跑異體 MSC 的臨床試驗，對製程與法規的理解不是紙上談兵。

updates.text: 獲 ScaleReady 的 G-Rex® Grant，將建立 G-Rex 製造的歐洲樞紐
啟動 iPSC 衍生 β 細胞program，獲 Bpifrance 1,200 萬歐元支持
與 CHU Toulouse 啟動 A-MUSE Ph1/2，評估 CellReady 異體 MSC 平台於全身性硬化症

en.mechanism: Cell therapy CDMO with its own CellReady allogeneic mesenchymal stem cell platform; handles 15 cell types including T cells, NK cells, Tregs, MSCs, iPSCs and immortalised lines
en.pipeline: Contract development and manufacturing plus an in-house platform | Based in Toulouse; the A-MUSE Ph1/2 with Toulouse University Hospital (CHU Toulouse) evaluates the CellReady allogeneic MSC platform in systemic sclerosis, initiated January 2026
en.insight: The only French operator combining allogeneic MSC manufacturing capability with a clinical programme of its own, on a quality system aligned to ICH Q2(R1), the European Pharmacopoeia and EMA/MHRA. Its significance to Steminent is as a European second option — Histocell is the shortest path, following an existing REPROCELL relationship westward, while Cell-Easy is an alternative assessable independently of any existing relationship, and one running its own allogeneic MSC trial, so its grasp of process and regulation is not theoretical.

updates.text: Awarded a G-Rex Grant by ScaleReady to establish a European hub for G-Rex-based manufacturing
Launched an iPSC-derived beta cell programme backed by €12M from Bpifrance
Initiated the A-MUSE Ph1/2 with CHU Toulouse evaluating the CellReady allogeneic MSC platform in systemic sclerosis

name: CELLforCURE（SEQENS）
ticker: SEQENS 集團 Part of SEQENS
mechanism: 細胞與基因治療 CDMO；自體與異體皆可的端對端製造平台
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜巴黎近郊 10,000 m² 廠區，其中 2,200 m² 為 GMP 分級製造空間；六條獨立產線、每條八間無塵室，年產能達數百批次，涵蓋 Ph1 至商業規模；承接 CellProthera 的 Ph3 GMP 製造
insight: 法國規模最大的 CGT 受託製造廠之一，且已有承接他家 Ph3 商業級製造的實績。與 Cell-Easy 的差異在定位：Cell-Easy 兼具自有臨床程式、規模較小但懂 MSC；CELLforCURE 純受託但廠區規模與後期臨床經驗較完整。若仲恩歐洲走到後期臨床或商業供貨，這裡的產能層級才接得住。

updates.text: 承接 CellProthera 的 Ph3 GMP 製造，技轉後預計自 2026 起產出臨床批次

en.name: CELLforCURE by SEQENS
en.mechanism: Cell and gene therapy CDMO offering an end-to-end platform for both autologous and allogeneic products
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | A 10,000 m² site near Paris including 2,200 m² of GMP-classified manufacturing space; six independent production lines of eight cleanrooms each, with annual capacity of several hundred batches spanning Phase 1 to commercial scale; manufactures CellProthera's Phase 3 material
en.insight: One of France's largest CGT contract manufacturing sites, with a track record of taking on another company's Phase 3 commercial-grade production. It differs from Cell-Easy in positioning: Cell-Easy is smaller but pairs MSC expertise with a clinical programme of its own, while CELLforCURE is purely a contract manufacturer with more complete late-phase experience and greater site scale. If Steminent's European track reaches late-stage clinical or commercial supply, this is the capacity tier that can carry it.

updates.text: Taking on Phase 3 GMP manufacturing for CellProthera, with clinical batches expected from 2026 following technology transfer

name: CellProthera
mechanism: 自體再生細胞治療，適應症為缺血性疾病
pipeline: ProtheraCytes®｜心肌梗塞後心臟修復；已選定 CELLforCURE by SEQENS 進行 Ph3 GMP 製造，技轉後自 2026 起產出臨床批次
insight: 法國本土的再生細胞治療開發者。適應症（缺血性心臟疾病）與 SCA 無交集，但它示範了一件對仲恩直接有用的事：**一家中型細胞治療公司如何在歐洲把製造外包給 CDMO 並推進到 Ph3**。仲恩在歐洲面對的正是同一道題——自建產能不現實，靠誰、以什麼合約形態接手，它已經走過一遍。

updates.text: 選定 CELLforCURE by SEQENS 進行 Ph3 GMP 製造

en.mechanism: Autologous regenerative cell therapy for ischaemic disease
en.pipeline: ProtheraCytes | Cardiac repair after myocardial infarction; selected CELLforCURE by SEQENS for Phase 3 GMP manufacturing, with clinical batches expected from 2026 after technology transfer
en.insight: A French regenerative cell therapy developer. Its indication in ischaemic heart disease does not intersect SCA, but it demonstrates something directly useful: how a mid-sized cell therapy company outsources European manufacturing to a CDMO and still reaches Phase 3. That is precisely Steminent's European problem — building capacity is unrealistic, so the question is who takes it on and under what contractual form, and this company has already walked that path.

updates.text: Selected CELLforCURE by SEQENS for Phase 3 GMP manufacturing

name: Avrion Therapeutics
mechanism: 精準基因療法平台：以單一載體同時、選擇性地把治療基因送進腦內的神經元與星形膠質細胞
pipeline: AVR-001｜SOD1 突變型 ALS，準備進入 IND-enabling，已於囓齒類與非人靈長類模型驗證；AVR-002｜針對神經免疫機轉，設計涵蓋家族性與偶發性 ALS 全體病人
insight: 2020 年成立、洛桑聯邦理工學院（EPFL）Brain Mind Institute 與 Bertarelli 基金會基因療法平台的衍生公司，總部巴塞爾。與仲恩的交集不在適應症而在**細胞層級的遞送**：它主張同時打神經元與星形膠質細胞才有協同效益，這個「不能只顧神經元」的論點，正好呼應 MSC 旁分泌作用於整個神經膠質環境的機轉敘事。若其非人靈長類遞送數據成立，對「中樞遞送做不到」這個 SCA 領域的共同天花板是重要參考。

updates.text: AVR-001 準備進入 IND-enabling 研究

en.name: Avrion Therapeutics AG
en.mechanism: A precision gene therapy platform delivering therapeutic genes selectively and simultaneously to both neurons and astrocytes in the brain from a single vector
en.pipeline: AVR-001 | SOD1-linked ALS, preparing to enter IND-enabling studies, validated in rodent and non-human primate models; AVR-002 | targets a neuroimmune mechanism and is designed for all ALS patients, whether familial or sporadic
en.insight: Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Basel, a spin-off from EPFL's Brain Mind Institute and the Bertarelli Foundation Gene Therapy Platform. Its overlap with Steminent lies not in indication but in cell-level delivery: its thesis that synergistic benefit requires targeting neurons and astrocytes together echoes the argument that MSC paracrine action works across the whole glial environment rather than on neurons alone. If its non-human primate delivery data holds, it is an important reference point for the CNS delivery ceiling that constrains the whole SCA field.

updates.text: AVR-001 preparing to enter IND-enabling studies

name: Cell Therapies Pty Ltd
mechanism: 細胞與基因治療 CDMO；自體與異體流程皆可
pipeline: 受託製造服務｜墨爾本維多利亞綜合癌症中心，與 Peter MacCallum 癌症中心同址；13 間專建無塵室（10 間支援早中期臨床、3 間大規模高通量支援後期與商業化），商業套房年產能達 2,000 劑
insight: **這一家的關鍵不是產能而是查廠紀錄**：已通過 TGA、FDA、EMA 與 PMDA 多次查核，並持有日本 MHLW 認證。仲恩的日本申請正在 PMDA 手上，而日本核准後需要能供貨的 GMP 廠——一座同時被 PMDA 查過、又位在亞太時區的商業級廠房，在整份名單裡是獨一無二的組合。產品範圍涵蓋 CAR-T、TCR、NK 與再生醫療產品。

updates.text: 與 AdAlta 簽署首份工作訂單，將 BZDS1901 製造移入澳洲；並與 Oribiotech、AdAlta 合作因應細胞治療製造挑戰

en.name: Cell Therapies Pty Ltd (CTPL)
en.mechanism: Cell and gene therapy CDMO supporting both autologous and allogeneic workflows
en.pipeline: Contract manufacturing | At the Victorian Comprehensive Cancer Centre in Melbourne, co-located with the Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre; 13 purpose-built cleanrooms (10 GMP suites for early- to mid-phase trials, 3 large-scale high-throughput suites for late-phase and commercial work), with commercial capacity up to 2,000 patient doses a year
en.insight: What matters here is the inspection record rather than the capacity: the site has passed numerous inspections by the TGA, FDA, EMA and PMDA, and holds MHLW accreditation for Japan. Steminent's Japanese application sits with the PMDA, and approval will require a GMP site able to supply — a commercial-scale plant that has been inspected by the PMDA and sits in an Asia-Pacific time zone is a combination unique on this list. Its product scope covers CAR-T, TCR and NK therapies alongside regenerative medicine products.

updates.text: Signed a first work order with AdAlta to bring BZDS1901 manufacturing to Australia, and joined Oribiotech and AdAlta on cell therapy manufacturing challenges

name: CCRM Nordic
mechanism: 再生醫學商業化中心的北歐分支；製程開發與 GMP 製造
pipeline: GMP 與製程開發設施｜規劃於 2027 年第二季啟用
insight: **這是整份名單裡最有槓桿的一條線索**：它是加拿大 CCRM 的北歐分支，而 CCRM 已經因 OmniaBio 與 Medipost 的關係列在優先序 1。同一個組織網絡橫跨北美與北歐，代表與 CCRM 建立一次關係、可以同時打開兩個市場的門。缺點是設施要到 2027 Q2 才啟用，趕不上仲恩目前的時程，屬於中期選項。

updates.text: GMP 與製程開發設施規劃啟用（尚未營運）

en.mechanism: The Nordic arm of a regenerative medicine commercialisation centre, covering process development and GMP manufacturing
en.pipeline: GMP and process development facilities | Scheduled to open in Q2 2027
en.insight: The single highest-leverage lead on this list: it is the Nordic arm of Canada's CCRM, which already sits at priority 1 through its OmniaBio relationship with Medipost. One organisational network spanning North America and the Nordics means a single relationship with CCRM could open doors in two markets at once. The drawback is that the facilities only open in Q2 2027, too late for Steminent's current timeline, making this a medium-term option.

updates.text: GMP and process development facilities scheduled to open; not yet operational

name: Cell & Gene Therapy SWEDEN／ATMP Center
nameEn: Cell & Gene Therapy SWEDEN / ATMP Center
mechanism: 瑞典先進治療醫療產品（ATMP）的國家協調機制；成員含七所醫學大學、七所大學醫院與七家生技／製藥／醫材業者
pipeline: 國家協調與 GMP 基礎設施｜Skåne 大學醫院 ATMP Center 於 2025 年初啟用，以多能幹細胞依 GMP 製造先進治療產品；隆德大學設有 pre-GMP 設施；規劃於 2026 下半年完成完整聯盟編組與財務安排
insight: 瑞典把分散的學術與醫院產能整合成單一入口，這對外來者的意義是**不必逐一敲門**。歷史上瑞典的 CGT GMP 基礎設施自 1990 年代末即運作，2014 年更做出歐洲第一批進入臨床試驗的 CAR-T，底子不淺。對仲恩而言，這是進入北歐臨床與製造網絡的統一窗口，適合在歐洲策略成形後再接觸。

updates.text: 規劃完成完整聯盟編組與財務、營運安排
Skåne 大學醫院 ATMP Center 啟用，依 GMP 製造多能幹細胞來源的先進治療產品

en.name: Cell & Gene Therapy SWEDEN / ATMP Center
en.mechanism: Sweden's national coordination function for advanced therapy medicinal products, with members drawn from seven medical universities, seven university hospitals and seven biotech, pharmaceutical and medtech companies
en.pipeline: National coordination and GMP infrastructure | The ATMP Center at Skåne University Hospital opened in early 2025, manufacturing advanced therapies from pluripotent stem cells under GMP; Lund University operates a pre-GMP facility; full consortium formation with financing and operations is planned for the second half of 2026
en.insight: Sweden has consolidated scattered academic and hospital capacity into a single point of entry, which for an outsider means not having to knock on doors one at a time. Swedish CGT GMP infrastructure has been running since the late 1990s and produced the first CAR-T cells to enter a clinical trial anywhere in Europe in 2014, so the foundations are deep. For Steminent this is a unified gateway into Nordic clinical and manufacturing networks, best approached once the European strategy has taken shape.

updates.text: Full consortium formation with financing and operations planned
The ATMP Center at Skåne University Hospital opened, manufacturing pluripotent stem cell-derived advanced therapies under GMP

name: BioSenic（原 Bone Therapeutics）
mechanism: ALLOB：骨髓間質幹細胞體外培養分化而成的異體成骨細胞產品
pipeline: ⚠️ ALLOB 已擱置｜脛骨骨折 Ph2b 未達療效終點，早期給藥未能顯著加速癒合，2023-06 宣布暫停開發。公司重心已轉向來自 Medsenic 的口服三氧化二砷，備戰慢性移植物抗宿主病 Ph3
insight: 2022-10 由 Bone Therapeutics 與法國 Medsenic 反向合併而成，位於 Mont-Saint-Guibert 的 Louvain-la-Neuve 科學園區。**列在這裡是作為警訊而非機會**：這是又一個異體 MSC 衍生產品在 Ph2b 折戟、且公司隨即轉向非細胞資產的案例。值得注意的是失敗發生在療效而非安全性——ALLOB 注射的安全性紀錄良好、無相關嚴重不良事件。這正是異體 MSC 的典型困境：安全過得去，療效證不出來。

updates.text: ALLOB 脛骨骨折 Ph2b 療效未達標，宣布暫停開發，重心轉向口服三氧化二砷
Bone Therapeutics 與 Medsenic 反向合併，更名 BioSenic

en.name: BioSenic (formerly Bone Therapeutics)
en.mechanism: ALLOB, an allogeneic osteoblastic product derived from bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells cultured and differentiated ex vivo
en.pipeline: ALLOB on hold | The Phase 2b in tibial fractures missed its efficacy endpoint, with early administration failing to accelerate healing significantly, and development was suspended in June 2023. The company has shifted its focus to oral arsenic trioxide acquired from Medsenic, preparing a Phase 3 in chronic graft-versus-host disease
en.insight: Formed in October 2022 by a reverse merger of Bone Therapeutics with France's Medsenic, based at the Louvain-la-Neuve Science Park in Mont-Saint-Guibert. It is listed here as a warning rather than an opportunity: another allogeneic MSC-derived product that failed at Phase 2b, after which the company pivoted to a non-cell asset. Notably the failure was on efficacy rather than safety — ALLOB injections had a good safety record with no related serious adverse events. That is the characteristic bind of allogeneic MSCs: safety clears, efficacy does not.

updates.text: ALLOB missed efficacy in the tibial fracture Phase 2b; development suspended and focus moved to oral arsenic trioxide
Bone Therapeutics and Medsenic merged in reverse, renaming the company BioSenic

name: Quince Therapeutics
mechanism: 自體紅血球包覆藥物遞送平台（AIDE）：將地塞米松磷酸鈉包入病人自身紅血球，作為緩釋載體長時間低劑量釋放類固醇
pipeline: eDSP（EryDex）｜共濟失調微血管擴張症（A-T）：Ph3 NEAT（NCT06193200）已完成，2026/08 發表全文，主要終點未達顯著（p=0.085）
insight: 2026/08/18 主動掃描發現的清單外玩家——其三期資產此前完全未被本平台收錄。與本社無適應症或市場重疊（A-T 為 ATM 缺陷所致之隱性共濟失調，非 polyQ 疾病），不構成直接競爭威脅。追蹤價值在兩點：一是 A-T 屬本平台既已追蹤的鄰近共濟失調圈層；二是 NEAT 以 RmICARS 為主要終點在六個月窗口內未達顯著（差值 −1.30、CI 上緣僅略越零界），與 SARA 同屬臨床醫師評分量表，可作為終點敏感度與追蹤期設計的外部參照。惟 A-T 為兒童期快速進展疾病，量表行為不能直接外推至成人晚發 SCA。

en.mechanism: An autologous red-blood-cell drug-delivery platform (AIDE): dexamethasone sodium phosphate is encapsulated in the patient's own erythrocytes, which act as a slow-release carrier giving prolonged low-dose steroid exposure
en.pipeline: eDSP (EryDex) | ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T): the Phase 3 NEAT trial (NCT06193200) has completed and was published in full in 2026/08, with the primary endpoint missed (p=0.085)
en.insight: An off-list player picked up by the 2026/08/18 sweep — its Phase 3 asset had never been captured on this platform at all. There is no overlap with our own indication or market (A-T is a recessive ataxia caused by ATM deficiency, not a polyQ disease), so it poses no direct competitive threat. It is worth tracking for two reasons: A-T sits in the adjacent ataxia ring the platform already covers, and NEAT's failure to reach significance on an RmICARS primary endpoint within a six-month window (difference −1.30, upper confidence bound only just crossing zero) offers an external reference point on endpoint sensitivity and follow-up duration, RmICARS being a clinician-rated scale like SARA. A-T is nonetheless a rapidly progressing childhood disease, and its scale behaviour does not extrapolate directly to adult late-onset SCA.
